description: Reprint of The Fourth Doctor, from Doctor Who comic strips from Doctor Who Magazine (originally by Marvel UK). These strips differ from the originals in that they had color added.
The final issue of Marvel Premiere! Present a truly bizarre science-fiction blockbuster starring everyone’s favorite intergalactic troublemaker: Star-Lord.

.In his task to prevent Shuma Gorath from enslaving the Earth and its people Doctor Strange finds himself traveling to England where he battles the powerful sea creature, Dagoth. Although besting him in their first encounter Dagoth frees himself and almost leads Strange to a watery grave. Clea arrives in time to snap Strange out of it. Instead of killing Dagoth like the two prior minions of Shuma Gorath Strange banishes him to another dimension never to set foot on Earth again. However, he soon discovers yet another menace is about to threaten the people of Earth.

issue_title: The Doom that Bloomed on Kathulos!
description: After quelling a possessed house Doctor Strange heads to Stonehenge, the site of something sinister brewing. There he battles a horde of mercilous demons, but dispatches them with ease. Following that he is torn from the Earth and sent to another world where he faces Kathulos, a man-plant with strong mystic powers. Strange is nearly absorbed into his psyche, but learns the means of Kathulos' defeat. After the man-plant shrivels and dies Strange is left on the desolate world without any clue on how to get back to Earth and prevent the coming of Shuma-Gorath!

Strange escapes the desolate, lifeless planet following a mystic trail of energies. He encounters Shuma-Gorath on his journey and eventually touches down outside the Kaa-u crypts. He finds his mentor, the Ancient One, near death and learns that is exactly the Ancient One's desire. The secret behind Shuma-Gorath's rebirth is revealed, but what does it have to do with the Ancient One?!

Notes:

  • The cover is a homage of the cover of Baffling Mysteries #7.

issue_title: Red of Fang and Claw, All Love Lost
description:
Shang-Chi is once again haunted by his malicious father's past.

Shows the early conflicts between Fah Lo Suee and Nayland Smith; also introduces Jack the Ripper.

issue_title: Not Smoke, Nor Beads, Nor Blood...
description: Shang-Chi is forced into direct conflict with Yakuza.

issue_title: A Vision of Winter in Spring!
description:
Shang-Chi absconds to the south of France to recuperate, but trouble still seems to find him.

Shang-Chi was sent to Provence, South France,to rest, and there he met and fell in love for Luciane D'Hiver.

Lady Renée de Peyraud ask for Shang-Chi to protect her, once she is being treatened because some big Oil Company deals. After the night, with Shang-Chi standing guard outside her door, she awakes blind, poisoned. Next night, Shang-Chi stays inside her room, and is attacked by a machine scorpion, just like his father used to create. Meanwhile a robot fly attacks Lady Peyraud causing a heart attack. Shang-Chi had failed and is searching for the killer, when is attacked by Anton Paulve, just because of Luciane. The real killer shows up but is killed by Anton.

At the end Shang-Chi discovers that it was actually Luciane herself who had attacked Lady Peyraud, and she is actually the villain Diadem, working for Oil Companies. She left Shang-Chi paralyzed and went away after a kiss.

Leiko is missing and only Shang-Chi can find her!

Shang-Chi and Black Tarr were sent by British MI-6 to Hong Kong, at the docks, in a City Asea above ships, to look for Leiko Wu, who had disappeared there. There they find their contact - Juliette, former agent of MI-6 and former lover of Shang's enemy Cat. Juliette tells that Leiko went to the center of the island - formed by the ships into the ocean, looking for and ancient German ship. In the main boat Shang-Chi finds Leiko, but she is with Cat. Then a fight begins.
Shang-Chi comes face-to-face with the only foe he has never truly defeated.
Leiko and Shang-Chi try to save Pavane from the assassin Razor Fist.

Leiko and Shang-Chi try to break into the fortress of Velcro.

The story opens with Shang-Chi and Leiko at Pavane's country house outside London, torturing one of Velcro's henchmen. The henchman breaks and tells them that his brother is another Razorfist made by Carlton Velcro to replace the first Razorfist that Shang-Chi had previously killed. He also tells them that Velcro is hiding at Marquesas Island, South Pacific. Shang-Chi and Leiko Wu make plans to go there, but Sir Smith insists on calling (Black Tarr and Clive Reston) in as backup.

Shang-Chi and Leiko jump to the island from a plane and enter the fortress. There they split. Shang-Chi finds Razorfist II and a fight ensues. Razorfist II confronts Shang-Chi about the death of the first Razorfist, and Shang-Chi explains that it was actually Velcro that killed him. Razorfist II confronts Velcro in a brief confrontation that ends his life. At the end, Shang-Chi fights Velcro, defeating him when he cuts off his false arm. Shang-Chi and Leiko finally kiss.

issue_title: A Painless Result of Having Lived
description:
After fasting, Shang-Chi is weakened before his showdown with Sata.

Shang-Chi takes a sabbatical to Napels where he is promptly given a mysterious mission to retrieve someone known as Dark Angel. His investigation goes well until his way is barred by the master assassin known as Sata. Shang-Chi is goaded into a fight for his life where he must overcome the weakness of his own spirit before that spirit is snuffed out forever.

*Master of Kung Fu features supporting characters created by the great Sax Rohmer.
When Shang-Chi accepts a job as a bodyguard, he wonders if the person he's protecting is actually the danger himself.

Featuring the deadly return of Zaran the Weapons Master!

Shang -Chi has to fight against Zaran after Fah Lo Suee left him and make him become anger with Dark Angel. Shang-Chi stops him and almost kill him after a fight during a hunting game. Meanwhile Clive Reston breaks up with Melissa.

Shang-Chi fights the Ghost Maker as he tries to thwart the KGB's latest attempt at tracking down the Dark Angel.

Notes:

  • This issue along with Ghosts #112, Warlord #56 and Master of Kung Fu #112 appeared on the comic book rack in the convenience store scene in the movie Friday the 13th Part 3.
Leiko and Shang-Chi continue to try and hunt down the Ghost Maker and stop the incoming acid rainstorm.

Shang-Chi and MI-6 finally go their separate ways.

Notes:

  • This issue along with Ghosts #112, Warlord #56 and Master of Kung Fu #110 appeared on the comic book rack in the convenience store scene in the movie Friday the 13th Part 3.
Shang-Chi and his team finish their business in Toronto before turning their attention to a cache of diamonds in Africa.

issue_title: A Fantasy Of The Autumn Moon
description: Shang-Chi battles Fu Manchu's most dangerous assassin in this fan favorite.
Shang-Chi's former employer, Sir Denis, suddenly finds himself completely destitute - how will they finance their next deadly mission?
Fu Manchu gets the upper hand over his son when a giant scorpion poisons Shang-Chi.
Even if he escapes the clutches of Fu Manchu, Shang-Chi will have to make it past the Death Dealer and his father's experiments - a dungeon of weaponized animals.
If he is to brew the Elixir Vitae and reach immortality, Fu Manchu will have to obtain a key ingredient - the blood of his son and mortal enemy, Shang-Chi.
Mordillo and his army of war machines once again attack Shang-Chi and his friends.
Shang-Chi and his CIA buddy Rufus Carter must stop a vengeful ghost's buried treasure from being disturbed.
Shang-Chi races spies and secret agents to a secret codebook.
Reston's solo endeavor turns out to be a trap, forcing Shang and Leiko to go on a rescue mission.
Expecting to reunite with his mother, Shang-Chi returns to New York but encounters assassins everywhere he turns.
Shang-Chi visits the temple where his father, the diabolical Fu Manchu, was trained.

The dramatic conclusion of the Master of Kung Fu's story!

This is the final issue of Master of Kung Fu. Shang-Chi is meditating at his father's castle in China afterkilling his own father. He fights demons a giant turtle and almost destroy a movie shooting scene. Shang-Chi joins the team of theater

In Scotland Leiko, Black Jack and Nayland Smith are worried about Shang-Chi.

The theather group are staging a play called "Damn son" and that highlights Shang's memories about his battle with his father. Suddenly he screams and runs away from the place towards a small village. There he has visions with his half-brother Midnight, his deceased mother, Leiko, and the death of his father. He battles his vision and a ninja dressed as Death retrieve his freedom and redemption.

Shang Chi confronts Sir Denis about Black Jack Tarr and the evil Fu Manchu's scheming!

Cameo appearances by Jim Starlin, Steve Engleheart and Al Milgrom.
Will Shang-Chi evade his father's capture long enough to destroy a shipment of sedative-laced gasoline?

Wounded and stalked by Fu Manchu's assassins Jekin and Dahar, Shang-Chi makes his way through the Florida swamps. Meanwhile, Sir Denis partners up with Black Jack Tarr to try and put an end to Fu Manchu!
Smalltime hood Demmy Marston wants to collect the reward on Shang-Chi's head and hires Korain the samurai, a former affiliate of Fu Manchu's to carry out the job!
Demmy Marston holds Shang-Chi responsible for the death of his girlfriend at the hands of Korain…and puts a price on his head! Add Marston to the list of folks who want the Master of Kung Fu dead!

While eating at a Chinese restaurant, Shang-Chi is nearly killed by murderous waiters! But that's the least of his problems -- Sir Denis and Black Jack Tarr are still in captivity, and Fu Manchu wants to destroy Mount Rushmore!
When Sir Denis Nayland asks for an audience with Shang-Chi, the two get wrapped up in unraveling Fu Manchu's plot to collaborate with a former Gestapo agent!
Shang-Chi infiltrates a group of criminals breaking into a compound in a remote part of Brazil!

issue_title: Rites of Courage, Fists of Death!
description: Shang-Chi, Sir Denis and Black Jack Tarr have managed to keep Fu Manchu from getting his hands on a nuclear weapon, but they now face a long walk home through the remote wilderness of the Amazon…where a tribe of brutal headhunters are sure to complicate things!
Sir Denis is after the long-lost Golden Beetle relic of the pharaoh Seth-Amon -- a legend relayed to him in a dream by none other than Fah Lo Suee…Shang-Chi's sister.
Shang-Chi confronts his father over a cold-blooded murder at long last!
Sir Denis Nayland Smith has been kidnapped, and an esoteric message on a bamboo scroll is the only lead Shang-Chi has!
Sir Denis has a proposal for Shang-Chi on how best to use his extraordinary martial arts skills (besides attacking his dad).
Shang-Chi busts into Carlton Velcro's castle to bring down the heroin ring.
Shang-Chi, Black Jack Tarr and Clive Reston try to disarm Velcro's stockpile of nukes!
Sir Denis puts Shang-Chi and Black Jack Tarr on a boat to London for their next mission!
Clive Reston sends a car to pick up Shang-Chi and Black Jack Tarr, but they have barely set foot in England when a robot attacks them!

issue_title: Cyclone at the Center of a Madman's Crown!
description: Shang-Chi and Clive Reston fly to Mordillo's secluded island in the East China Sea to find Leiko.

issue_title: Death Hand and the Sun of Mordillo
description: Continued from #34, Shang-Chi and Reston race against the clocks to save Leiko from the hourglass!

issue_title: Cages of Myth, Managerie of Mirrors!
description: The Master of Kung Fu returns to Manhattan for the first appearance of the MOON SUN'S CIRCUS!
Can Shang-Chi fight his way out of the grip of Darkstrider and his Warlords of the Web?
Martial arts madness featuring the first appearance of THE CAT!
It's Shang-Chi versus the Cat in the Master of Kung Fu’s most equally-skilled match yet!
Shang-Chi, the son of Fu Manchu, battles his father's league of deadly assassins in "The Murder Agency!"
Martial arts madness in the mighty Marvel manner - featuring appearances from M'Nai and Cho Lin!
Shang-Chi must defeat Shockwave in hand-to-hand combat before his time bomb detonates!
More martial arts mayhem as Shang-Chi faces an electrifying death at the hands of Shockwave!
It's father versus son once more, as Fu Manchu reappears in Death-Day of the Golden Dagger!
The son of Fu Manchu must now defeat his sister's team of assassins!
Shang-Chi takes on the unstoppable SUMO -- but are mere Kung Fu skills enough?
War in an Arctic wasteland! Shang-Chi alone can defeat the forces of his father Fu Manchu.

issue_title: City in the Top of the World
description:
Shang-Chi's everlasting fight against his father Fu Manchu continues in "The Bridge of a Thousand Dooms!"

This issue is narrated by Black Jack Tarr, while he is going after Shang Chi and Leiko towards Fu Manchu's fortress in Artic. Sir Denis is following Jack's steps by radio from London.

Inside the fortress Fu Manchu is telling all his plans of taking over the World to his Si-Fan Ninjas. He aims first to destroy it and then rule the ruins.

Black Jack finds Larner and Fah Lo Suee next to the cave entranc of the fortress while in another tunnel Shang Chi, Leiko and Clive Reston are looking for an entrance to the fortress city. Lo Suee tells Black Jack about her dad's plans of destroying the World by causing a series of nuclear explosion on the Moon and with that modify the Moon's trajectory, causing cataclismic changes in the continents and seas. Because of that she rebels against her father and fight him, but she lost and now Fu Manchu is trying to kill her.

Shang Chi discover a boat in the caves and by the river they reach the City in the top of the World - Fu Manchu's fortress. Black Jack swims after them, while Fu Manchu sends his ninjas to kill our heroes. With his magic powers he succeded on giving back life to the legendary warrior Shaka Kharn. Shang Chi easily defeats a huge number of Si-Fans and at the end becomes face to face to Shaka Kharn.

issue_title: The Affair Of The Agent Who Died!
description: Shaka Kharn, the demon warrior, was given life by Fu Manchu -- in order to bring death to his son, Shang-Chi!
Shang-Chi and Clive Reston aren’t dead under the rubble of a fallen fortress -- they actually are on Fu Manchu's rocket ship! And now Shang-Chi must face his father’s rage!
Sir Denis Nayland Smith calls a meeting of his surviving agents in the wake of James Larner’s funeral.
Shang-Chi bumps into Rufus T. Hackstabber in Morocco.

Hoping to take the prize on Shang-Chi's head, minor criminal Demmy Marston hires a samurai to pursue the Master of Kung Fu!

This is a reprint of MOKF # 20
Death has three faces! Featuring an appearance by the ferocious War-Yore!
Shang-Chi races against the clock to save himself from certain death!

issue_title: Of Heroes Past and Battles Present
description: Shang-Chi, Reston and Tarr take on a villain who can mirror several fighting styles from history's best warriors!
2,000 feet above modern-day London, Shang-Chi duels a foe from the past!
Shang-Chi squares off against War-Yore, the Murder Master, once more!

Shang-Chi might be burned in the aftermath to the “Phoenix Gambit”! Plus, who is the Angel of Doom?

Part I : Temples of Time

Shang-Chi's deadliest foes return, this time as pawns of Marvel's master of macabre villainy -- DOCTOR DOOM!

The Phoenix Gambit Part II : End Game
Shang-Chi takes on the Skull-Crusher, while several of his friends deal with personal blows in their love lives.
A savage new quest for Shang-Chi starts here!
Shang-Chi battles the Cat and Skull-Crusher in "Hiding Cats!"

issue_title: Deadly Lesson: Like Father... Like Son?
description: Get a rare glimpse at Shang-Chi's childhood in "Deadly Lesson: Like Father, Like Son…?"
Shang-Chi must choose the lady or the tiger -- either way, it's death!
Shang-Chi may have just found a worthy opponent in the brutal pirate Kogar!
All of Shang-Chi’s allies and enemies come together for a fateful confrontation that will end in death!
With Kogar in attendance, Shang-Chi has his final battle with Shen Kuei…A.K.A. the Cat!
Shang-Chi faces three deadly combatants in a Battle Royale before a final matchup with Skull-Crusher!
Murder Mansion…with a name this inviting, spy master Black Jack Tarr and Shang-Chi have no choice but to enter! What deadly traps lie in wait?
A change of pace: Shang-Chi gets a day off to reflect on his place in life, including Juliette's shocking admission.
The villainous Shockwave begins targeting Shang-Chi’s friends! But to what end?
Return to Mordillo Isle! Shang-Chi and Leiko battle some monstrous mutations on the island that time forgot!
Shang-Chi finds himself in an uneasy alliance with Shockwave when both of their lives come under danger on Mordillo Isle!
Shang-Chi battles Brynocki's army of robots with the aid of some allies.
Shang-Chi finds betrayal where he was looking for ancient knowledge!
Shang-Chi duels the Weapons Master while Black Jack looks for his friends.

Shang-Chi’s battle against Zaran takes him to Scotland!

Splash title = Tread The Night Softly

issue_title: To Sleep... This Side of Death!
description: The Master of Kung Fu must fight the drugs in his system in order to win his ongoing battle with Zaran.
Shang-Chi must fight Fu Manchu's leopard cult of assassins, although his father turns out not to be dead after all!
The leopard cultists get the better of Shang-Chi and his friends!
Shang-Chi's evil father, Fu Manchu, abducts Sir Denis!

issue_title: Warriors Of The Golden Dawn Part 1:The Phoenix And The Snake
description:
Fu Manchu gathers his greatest resources to plot his return.

Splash title = Warriors of the Golden Dawn / The Phoenix and the Snake
Shang Chi and Tarr reach Fu Manchu's headquarters in South America, while Reston and Leiko head to Casablanca.
This is it! Shang-Chi is abducted by his evil father!
Black Jack Tarr and Shang-Chi face Fu Manchu at last, but one of them may not leave his citadel alive!
Fah Lo Suee tries to build a coalition of heroes to fight Fu Manchu.
Fu Manchu unleashes the warrior Maru against his own son!
Shang-Chi has one last showdown with his father as he chases after Fu Manchu's flying saucer.
Upon the defeat of his evil father Fu Manchu, Shang-Chi parts ways with his crew and heads for Chinatown.

Shang-Chi is attacked by a street gang and decides to teach them a few things.

Splash title = Triumphs of the Spirit

Shang-Chi and Leiko investigate reports of a monster terrorizing the citizens of Chinatown.

Splash title = Shadows of a Silent Past
Black Jack Tarr enlists the help of Shang-Chi and Leiko to free his friend's sister.
Mandy must be stored away in Sir Denis’s Scottish castle to protect her from assassins!

Sir Denis Nayland Smith launches a freelance operation.

Splash title = The Samisdat Secret!
The C.I.A. twist Shang-Chi’s arm into helping them on a mission with Agent Carter.
Shang-Chi’s dinner party hits an unexpected snag when a gang of thieves crashes the scene!

Shang-Chi vs. the Shadow-Slasher! Is the Master of Kung Fu’s opponent the best at what he does?

A skilled and determined adversary, the Shadow-Slasher, seeks to make his name at the expense of Shang-Chi.

Shang-Chi collaborates with karate champion and ex-C.I.A. agent Rufus Carter to take down a crew of pirates.

Shang-Chi must team with Rufus "Super Midnight? Carter to prevent a deadly nautical sabotage. Leiko, weary of living in Chi's shadow, heads alone to Whitechapel to investigate some eerily familiar murders.

The saga of Iron Fist begins here! Marvel's mystical Kung Fu crime fighter takes center stage in his own ongoing series. First thing on-tap? Rescuing Detective Colleen Wing! Iron Man guest stars, (and dukes it out with Iron Fist.)

Believing that Stark Industries is behind the disappearance of Colleen Wing, Iron Fist infiltrates their facility, along with Misty Knight. Misty reveals that Colleen is her partner in running a detective agency, Nightwing Restorations. An intruder alarm is set off, alerting Tony Stark to the presence of intruders. He sets off to investigate the alarm as Iron Man. Iron Man and Iron Fist begin to fight.

Meanwhile, Colleen is taken to an airport. Her attempts to escape are thwarted. Misty Knight uncovers that Colleen is being taken to Halwan, and manages to break up the fight between Iron Man and Iron Fist, revealing that sleeper agents in Stark’s organisation were involved in the kidnapping, and that they are headed got Halwan. Iron Man apologises, saying he would help but has prior commitments. Iron Fist and Misty head out to find Colleen.

Iron Fist is on the lam after the Golden Tigers frame him for the murder of costumed hero William Hao. Misty Knight and Colleen Wing know the truth about Iron Fist, and will stop at nothing to help their friend and ally out of this sticky jam! Iron Fist vs. Chaka!

Iron Fist has been blamed for a murder and is being hunted by the police. His only hope is to prove his innocence by finding the real killer. Luckily for Iron fist not everyone in the police department believes he's a murderer. Misty Knight and Coleen Wing come to his aid. The team finds out that Chaka is behind the murder, so Iron Fist and his cohorts stage a daring plan to bring him out of hiding which results in a final battle for Iron Fist's freedom.

The Wrecking Crew crashes the New York City scene...quite literally! Alan Cavenaugh reflects on the sins of his past, while Misty Knight finds herself a hostage. Who is the Wrecking Crew really after? Jean Grey and Cyclops of the X-Men cameo!

Trespasser at Avengers Mansion! Captain America lunges into action when Iron Fist breaks into the Avengers’ HQ. But Cap has all the wrong ideas about Iron Fist; will Danny Rand be able to prove his innocence…and his heroism? Captain America and Iron Fist vs. the Wrecking Crew!

Iron Fist seeks the aid of Captain America to stop The Wrecking Crew from reaching the Avenger's mansion however things do not start well as Iron Fist has earned a bad reputation as the Kung Fu Killer. So When Iron Fist and Captain America meet, Combat between the two warriors start.

Misty Knight is determined to pull off a sting operation on a drug pusher, but her methods may put her in more danger than she realizes. Alan Cavenaugh may revert back to his terroristic ways, putting him in direct conflict with pacifist-at-heart Iron Fist. Will the IRA rise again?

Featuring the first appearance of X-Villain Sabretooth! Iron Fist and Colleen Wing are being hunted in the Canadian wilderness, at the mercy of its brutal snowstorms and hidden threats. Jeryn Hogarth, prisoner of Sabretooth! Will Colleen and Danny be able to save the man they swore to protect?

Colleen Wing calls in Iron Fist as her backup while she's serving as a bodyguard to Jeryn Hogarth. However, upon arriving at Hogarth's Canadian Mountain chalet, they discover the entire complex has been taken over by a crew of mercenaries led by none other than Sabertooth. Colleen and Iron Fist are taken captive but soon make their escape into the Canadian wilderness. They survive the night in spite of a deadly snow storm and return to the chalet. Colleen mounts a rescue, leaving a weakened and exhausted Iron Fist to face Sabertooth one on one.

Note: This is Sabertooth's first full on-panel appearance.

X-Men & Iron Fist Team-Up! Marvel’s mighty mutants take down the Bushmaster and Steel Serpent in Iron Fist’s final issue. Legendary X-Men scribe Chris Claremont delivers powerful storytelling…and punches!

Iron Fist is once again attacked from the shadows by Steel Serpent. The fight doesn't last long, and Steel Serpent soon retreats. Left weakened and disoriented by the attack, Iron Fist breaks into Misty Knight's apartment in search of help. Unfortunately, Misty's not there and Wolverine is watching the place, stalking her roommate Jean Grey, also not at home. Wolverine and Iron Fist start a brawl which snowballs into a full on war when the rest of the X-Men get involved.

Danny Rand, a.k.a. Iron Fist, feels the heat in his ‘failed attempt’ at saving Lee Wing. Iron Fist plays out a memory from K'un-Lun about a mysterious masked fighter. Who is Miranda Rand? And what is her blood relation to the Iron Fist? Misty Knight gets some valuable information off an informant in London. Will Lee Wing be avenged by those closest to him?

Note: Features the Hostess Fruit Pies ad, The Incredible Hulk And The Twins Of Evil!

Iron Fist and Misty Knight touch down in London…and are immediately attacked by the Ravager! Misty takes some serious blows, motivating Iron Fist to take action. But with the Ravager long gone, will Iron Fist’s man-hunt prove fruitless?

London’s on the verge of a radioactive melt-down, as Iron Fist takes on Radion! Danny Rand must call on his K'un-Lun teachings to heal himself, and find the spiritual guidance necessary to take down his worst foe yet. Who was Henri Sorel before he was a being of pure energy? Your answers revealed in this issue!

Radion reveals that by destroying his suit, Iron Fist has triggered an irreversible chain reaction. Radion has the power of a hydrogen bomb, and when he dies, London will be destroyed.

Meanwhile, in New York the Meachums and the mysterious man from last issue watch the battle on TV. The mysterious man reveals that because Iron Fist has the power he desires, he will kill him.

Back in London, Iron Fist lies at the brink of death, trapped under fallen debris. However, an apparition of Yu-Ti appears before him, inspiring him to channel the power of the Iron Fist to heal himself.

A nearby TV reveals the origin of Radion. He was once a scientist, Hernri Sorel, searching for a cure for radiation poisoning. A group of goons, hired by Ward Meachum, attempted to extort the cure from him, in order to exploit the cure for economic gain. He refused, a fight began, and he was dowsed with chemicals, turning him into Radion. Radion’s crimes are motivated by his desire to find a cure for his condition.Iron Fist finds the anti-radiation device Radion was going to use to cure himself.

Misty Knight tries to escape from hospital, but complications from her bionic arm cause her to collapse. Radion and Iron Fist continue to fight. Iron Fist manages to kick Radion into the anti-radiation device, turning Radion back into a human.

Note: This issue contains the Hostess Superhero Ad, Spider-Man and the Cupcake Caper.

Colleen Wing’s location is still classified, but Iron Fist is determined to blow the cover and rescue his friend. But before Danny can track Colleen, he must thwart an attack from angered civilians! Iron Fist makes ties to the IRA…but how? Colleen succumbs to the brainwashing powers of Angar the Screamer!

Colleen Wing is played off as a pawn, forced into battle with her ally Iron Fist! Is this the end of Colleen Wing the hero? Iron Fist pulls out all the Kung Fu kicks he can, including a mystical mind-merge to reacquaint Colleen with her true memories. Master Khan makes his next move.

The issue starts out with Iron Fist leaping from a glider to sneak attack a fortress in Jera'ad al-din, Halwan. Iron Fist quickly sneaks into the fortress taking out various guardsmen. As he moves through the Master's Fortress it is revealed that Iron Fist is in search of his girlfriend Colleen Wing. A flashback to London days earlier shows Danny Rand in conversation with Alan Cavanaugh - Colleen Wing is currently missing and Danny has been unable to find any clues to her whereabouts. Danny is picked up in London on a private jet by Jeryn Hogarth after receiving a telegram from the lawyer.. Misty Knight is on the flight - the first time Danny has seen her since she lost her arm. Jeryn reveals his identity as Wendell Rand's lawyer and informs Danny that he is actually a millionaire. Misty's NIght-Wing Restorations, Ltd. company had assisted Hogarth in confirming Danny's identity. Hogarth has a lead on Colleen Wing's location. Iron Fist suits up and prepares to assault the Master's Fortress. Before he para-glides from Hogarth's plane Misty Knight hands Iron Fist Colleen Wing's samurai sword. The flashback ends with Iron Fist attacking the fortress guards. As an interlude the Dragon Lord is seen watching Iron Fist in a strange green crystal. Lei Kung the Thunderer bursts into the Dragon Lord's chambers accusing the Dragon Lord of usurping the throne of K'un Lun from Wendell Rand - the Dragon Lord was Lord Tuan's second son. The Dragon Lord was jealous of Wendell and it is intimated that he even coveted Wendell's wife - Iron Fist's mother. The interlude ends and Iron Fist finds Colleen Wing. However, she quickly attacks him with the aid of Angar the Screamer who disorients Iron Fist. After a terrific battle, Iron Fist uses his Chi - the Power of the Iron Fist - to free Colleen Wing from her brainwashing - ending her attack. As Iron Fist kneels over Colleen Wing new soldiers enter the chamber and seize Iron Fist. Master Khan, from the shadows, orders Iron Fist's death - by beheading!

Danny makes a shocking discovery about his mother’s demise. How was Iron Fist’s mystic mentor Yu-Ti involved in Heather Rand’s death? Colleen Wing returns to her senses, and teams-up with Iron Fist to take down Angar the Screamer and his brainwashed lackeys!

New York City has been overrun by a Kung Fu street gang known only as the Golden Tigers. Sounds like the perfect case for mystical crime fighter Iron Fist! Danny Rand makes some inquiries into his father’s shadowy past. Will Rand ever find forgiveness for former mentor Yu-Ti?

Iron Fist finds a (very) worthy opponent in the Golden Tigers Gang. Leader Chaka shows his true colors, and swears to topple Ward Meachum. But why? Iron Fist accused of murder!

Iron Fist is poisoned by Chaka and is told that he has 5 minutes to run, and that he will be hunted by the Golden Tigers. If he can successfully make it past the Golden Tigers, he has a chance to live if he can defeat Chaka to get the poisons antidote.

With his powers slowly being siphoned, the weakening Iron Fist must face and defeat Master Khan to save Misty Knight and David Griffith!

Power Man has made to 100 and Iron Fist has been along on the ride for half that time. In this exciting issue the Heroes for Hire are faced with their deadliest challenge to date. Can diamond-hard fists and kung fu defeat the deadliest sorcerer from the land of K'un Lun, Master Khan?

With Power Man and Iron Fist out of commission, Colleen Wing and Misty Knight take over to stop the assassin Impasse.

Power Man and Iron Fist are out of commission. Now, with the assassin Impasse running around, it is up to Colleen Wing and Misty Knight to step in and pick up the slack.

Scarlet Witch guest-stars! Under the guise of "Ms. Wonderly", Scarlet Witch recruits Power Man and Iron Fist to safeguard the Twin Idol of Zor!

Can Power Man and Iron Fist stop a man known as the Doombringer before it's too late?

With world destruction as his goal, Doombringer lives up to his name! Will Power Man and Iron Fist be able to stop him?

Most super villains want to rule the world, but Doombringer. No, he wants to destroy it!

With Doombringer nowhere in sight, Power Man and Iron Fist are pressed to find him before he ushers forth Armageddon!

Can even Power Man and Iron Fist hope to stand against the cybernetically powered exo-skeleton of Doombringer?

The arrival of a new hero, Crime-Buster, brings fresh competition to the Heroes for Hire!

There's a new super hero in town by the name of Crime Buster. And, he's horning in on the Heroes for Hire's gig. Can Luke Cage and Iron Fist handle the competition?

The Heroes for Hire battle Whirlwind! Will Power Man and Iron Fist be able to stand their ground when Whirlwind summons up a storm?

Power Man and Iron Fist battle the swirling villainy of the man called Whirlwind.

Victor Kreeger antagonizes as the ‘Hammer of Judgment’! Even thick-skinned Power Man takes some slugs in this one!

Power Man and Iron Fist save a young man from the Hammer of Judgement, and more importantly, should they?

The Reaper is going to avenge the murder of a policeman... even if he has to kill innocent people to do it!

A troubled teen with a gun takes refuge in a church after he accidentally kills a police officer. Unfortunately, more than just the cops are looking for him. A friend of the cop wants revenge. The Heroes For Hire are called in to defuse the situation before it gets even worse in this stand-alone story.

Cage and The Fist hobnob with the social elite when they take Jeryn Hogarth's beautiful daughter to her debutante's ball! But... amid the glamor and glitter we find Nightshade, Stiletto, Discus, Man Mountain Marko, and the Eel! You'll never guess what they're doing there... and it's no picnic for our heroes! Guest starring Wonder Man, the Beast, and the Wasp!

When Power Man and Iron Fist are hired to escort a young woman to her prom they wind up battling half the super villains in their rogues gallery.
Who is Captain Hero? That's what Luke and Danny have to find out! Because this erratic new super hero wants to join Heroes For Hire!
Introducing special Government Security Agent Gordy! He's rough, he's tough, and he's mean, and he's on our side! For Power Man and Iron Fist, he's pure poison!
Captain Hero is taken to Project Pegasus. But when Danny Rand (Iron Fist) goes there, he discovers that someone, or something, is loose and systematically killing everyone in the complex!
One's got power, the other's got punch, and when they team up in a fight to the finish against Control 7, it's pure pandemonium!
Luke and Danny take a field test to prove their mettle to a potential client. But the test is a killer... literally!
Power Man is trapped inside an arctic bunker! Iron Fist is stranded outside! While Luke is starving to death, Danny is freezing to death! And there's no rescue in sight!
Danny is dying, and none of the world's scientists can help! Iron Fist must return to K'un-L'un, the fabled land of his teachers. But can even Power Man get him there in time
At last Iron Fist reaches his mystic homeland of K'un-Lun. But will he get the help he needs to stop the radiation sickness that's killing him?
Danny's life is saved but at what cost?

He's not just any dragon, he's Chiantang, brother of the Dragon King, the destroyer of K'un-Lun! And Iron Fist is not only going to fight, he's vowed to kill him!

Power Man and Iron Fist are in K'un-Lun to find a cure for Iron Fist's radiation poisoning. Accompanied by Colleen Wing, Luke and Danny find the city in ruins. This issue focuses on the team fighting Chiantang - the brother of the dragon king, who can assume both human and dragon form.

Feeling guilt for causing Chiantang's recent devastation of K'un-Lun, Iron Fist's costume turns red, and he's out of control.

This issue marks the last appearance of the "real" Iron Fist and his replacement with a doppelganger who would appear in the final issue of the series.
Secret Wars II tie-in! Upon their return from K'un-L'un, Luke and Danny realize that their prophetic dream about the Beyonder has actually come true…and now the Heroes for Hire HQ is solid gold!
Luke Cage teams-up with the Falcon. No Iron Fist in this issue.
Iron Fist battles ninjas and S.M.I.L.E. agents to seek answers for the guilt he's felt over being responsible for thousands of deaths due to his gaining the power of the Iron Fist.

It's the end of the road for the Heroes for Hire and crazy John Lumus wants to make sure they go out with a bang. And can it be...Luke Cage is accused of the murder of Danny Rand? Plus, twelve year old Bobby Wright's (Captain Hero) condition gets steadily worse. Can the chi of Iron Fist save the boy? In this issue witness the tragic death of two heroes. All this plus Power Man and Iron Fist take on the 1985 Super Bowl Champions the Chicago Bears in a football game.

Absolved of the crimes that landed him in Seagate Penitentiary, Luke Cage celebrates at the penthouse suite of his lawyer. While there, Cage reflects on his past; Power Man’s origins revealed! However, this reverie is disturbed when criminals Stiletto and Discus crash the party!

Luke Cage has cleared his name of the bogus charges that landed him in jail to begin with, and now he is free to start his life anew as a free man. Plus, Power Man and Iron Fist officially become a team, as reflected in the title. But will their first adventure as partners be their last when the deadly assassins Stiletto and Discus attack?

Luke Cage and Danny Rand encounter a robbery and decide to take action as Power Man and Iron Fist! But during combat, the dynamic duo realizes they’re attacking robots! Just what is going on here?

Luke decides to take Danny out for a night on the town. When they take a stroll through Harlem the Heroes for Hire find themselves in the middle of a bar room brawl. Plus, they end up facing the organized crime of the city and wind up fighting for their lives.

issue_title: A Nod is as Good as a Wink to a Dead Super-Hero…!
description:
Iron Fist’s life is in jeopardy when Joy Meachum offers Morgan substantial money to shoot Danny Rand! Meanwhile, Power Man seeks out Misty Knight, but falls to Simon Shreeve’s army of robots!

Iron Fist intends to find out who is building the racket-busting Cybernauts, but first he must rescue Joy Meachum from the clutches of Boss Morgan. Meanwhile, Luke Cage plays possum and winds up in the "Lion's Den."

After surviving a car crash and saving Misty’s life, Power Man reunites with Iron Fist! The two pursue Nightshade to her headquarters and find an entire army of robots waiting to pounce! Power Man and Iron Fist enter the fray with ‘unleashed death machines’!

After Luke Cage and Detective Misty Knight survive an attempt on their lives, Power Man and Iron Fist confront the malevolent Night Shade to put an end to the villainess' evil ways.

While Luke Cage meets with Jeryn Hogarth to discuss his Hero for Hire business, Danny Rand visits Joy Meachum with a proposition of his own. Afterwards, Power Man and Iron Fist stop a bank robbery! And new criminal “The Incinerator", poses a fiery threat!

Luke Cage and his new partner, Iron Fist, must confront the fiery menace of the Incinerator. Will this be the end of the newly formed Heroes for Hire duo?

Bull, a criminal who once fought the likes of Captain America, goes to a local car show with one thing on his mind: stealing the on-display Fantasti-car! Power Man and Iron Fist try to stop this raging villain, but unfortunately Bull brought back-up!

A criminal organization has stolen the famed Fantasticar, the flying automobile of the Fantastic Four. Now, it's up to the Heroes for Hire to get this potentially dangerous piece of machinery back without a scratch before it's too late.

Power Man and Iron Fist are hired to protect an exhibit of ancient Egyptian artifacts at the Metropolitan Museum. During the night, a robbery orchestrated by a dangerous villain goes down! Power Man and Iron Fist follow their lead to solve this crime, only to discover that the Living Monolith is the true mastermind!

In a friendly bout of sparring, Iron Fist shows Luke Cage one must be graceful and able to turn an opponent's strengths against him. However, we all know Power Man is second to none when it comes to good 'ole fashion fisticuffs. Plus, witness the awesome power of the Living Monolith unleashed.

The Living Monolith’s powers have been restored, and the Heroes for Hire can’t stand alone against this mutant menace! Teaming up with the Uncanny X-Men, Power Man and Iron Fist try to defeat the Living Monolith before the city is destroyed!

Power Man is strong, and Iron Fist has very few rivals in the martial arts, but even the Heroes for Hire are as nothing next to the raw power of the Living Monolith. Luckily, they'll get some help from the Children of the Atom when they take on this titanic menace.

A new vigilante named El Aguila is in town! Notorious for being a hero to the underprivileged, El Aguila faces crime with a sword that can shoot electricity! When Power Man and Luke Cage are forced by contract to detain the new hero, their ethical and moral codes are questioned; should the duo disobey their sworn duties and go against a contract, or do they stand up for a cause, and hero, they believe in?

A modern-day Robin Hood is about to go down hard. That is unless Power Man and Iron Fist have anything to say about it.

The Heroes for Hire get some backlash from the press when they are linked with J.P. Preston in the Bugle! Iron Fist and Misty Knight run into an old, suspicious friend, and the Big Apple Bomber wreaks havoc in the city!

Danny introduces Colleen to his sparring partner, Bob Diamond, a member of the martial arts crime fighting team known as the Sons of the Tiger. Plus, a mad-bomber endangers the lives of innocents.

Convinced Alan Cavenaugh is the Big Apple Bomber, the Heroes for Hire release their former friend to the NYPD. But there’s a greater threat lurking in the Halwani embassy! Iron Fist pays a visit to Princess Azir only to be attacked by her guards. Can the Heroes for Hire aid Iron Fist and uncover the Big Apple Bomber’s identity? Or will the city have to endure yet another explosion?

Danny's friend, Alan Cavenaugh, has been accused of being the mad-bomber that nearly killed hundreds of innocents. Can Power Man and Iron Fist clear his name before it's too late?

issue_title: Who's Been Sleeping In My Grave?
description:
When a wounded Big Ben Donovan crashes into the Gem Theater with blazing guns behind him, Power Man springs into action! And when Man Mountain Marko shows up to rival Power Man, Iron Fist joins the fray!

Big Ben, a rival from Luke Cage's past, comes crashing through the door, assassins hot on his heels, seeking his old sparring partner's help. Meanwhile, a misunderstanding sets Iron Fist against another old friend of Power Man's, the super-fast Thunderbolt.

Big Ben Donovan and Power Man, kidnapped by the Maggia! But Iron Fist and Thunderbolt are hot on the rescue trail; the duo infiltrates Caesar Cicero's penthouse for information…and track Cage and Donovan to a cemetery!

Luke Cage is at the mercy of a dangerous new adversary. Can Iron Fist and an aging Thunderbolt save their friend before he meets with a terrible fate.

After Power Man and Iron Fist put a stop to a number of Señor Suerte’s gambling rings, the Señor demands revenge! Power Man learns about a bomb planted in the Gem Theater. Time is ticking for the Heroes for Hire!

It's always a bad idea to set up an illegal casino in the neighborhood protected by Power Man and Iron Fist. Plus, when someone starts making attempts on the lives of friends, things get personal for the Heroes for Hire.

A bomb has gone off inside the Gem Theater, and the Heroes for Hire must hunt down the culprits! But the men responsible may have a few tricks up their sleeves; will Power Man and Iron Fist lose the Last Gamble?

Luke Cage makes it his personal mission to bring down a murderer.

El Aguila is back! The rogue vigilante tails Power Man and Iron Fist to Canada where a plot of thievery is underway! Can the Heroes for Hire manage to solve a crime and defend themselves from this possibly dangerous threat?

The modern day Robin Hood known as El Aguila is back. But this time the swashbuckling vigilante needs the Heroes for Hire's help.

Note: This issue contains the Hostess Superhero Ad, The Human Torch Saves The Valley

The Daughters of the Dragon are in need of Power Man and Iron Fist’s help! A group of thieves led by Sabretooth and Constrictor have stolen the Jade Tiger and ensnared Misty Knight! Our two heroes enter the vault…but may wish they hadn’t!

Private Investigators Misty Knight and Colleen Wing have tracked down the stolen jeweled statue, the Jade Tiger, but come face to face with two of the deadliest men alive. Constrictor, the man with the adamantium coils, and Sabretooth, the feral mutant killing machine. Wounded and knowing they've bitten off more then they can chew, Colleen calls in the reinforcements, Luke Cage and Danny Rand, a.k.a. Power Man and Iron Fist.

Second appearance of Sabretooth.

Bushmaster kidnaps Luke Cage after discovering a way to reverse his powers! Iron Fist must solve his partner’s disappearance and save Power Man before any experiment is conducted. Iron Fist vs. Weird Science!

Luke Cage is missing and Iron Fist must find him before the diabolical plans of an old enemy come to fruition. Plus, witness Power Man, the man with the diamond-hard skin, bleed.

Power Man without super powers! When a villain from his past targets him for revenge, Luke Cage struggles to put up a fight! Meanwhile, Iron Fist and friends infiltrate the Bushmaster’s mansion to free Emma Burstein!

Luke Cage's powers are failing. He's no longer bullet proof and his strength is no where near what it was. Now, Power Man's enemy Arthur Nagan, a bestial adversary, wants to take this opportunity to slay his troublesome foe.

Power Man and Iron Fist are hired to protect a group of mercenaries from the murderous Colonel Eschat! The Colonel is seeking out hits in order to protect his secret identity. District Attorney Blake Tower is in danger, and the Heroes for Hire are on the case!

Power Man and Iron Fist race against the clock to stop a madman.

Power Man and Iron Fist are hired by Supremo, dictator of Terranueva, to take down a drug ring! But when the heroes discover their employer has captured Colleen Wing and is part of the drug trade himself, Power Man and Iron Fist bite the hand that feeds them!

Power Man and Iron Fist head south to discover how drugs are being smuggled into Florida from South America. Colleen Wing comes along for the trip and finds more than she bargained for.

Luke Cage ends up getting a special quarter with the ability to manipulate machinery at a diner, and Montenegro is out to get back the special coin!

Have Power Man and Iron Fist finally met their match? They face an enemy who can out maneuver them at every turn. It will take their best teamwork to defeat Montenegro the man from the Black Mountain.

Iron Fist enrolls in multiple martial arts classes across the city to try to find the identity of the new Chaka, head of the Golden Tigers!

Iron Fist's old enemy, Chaka, is back and he's deadlier than ever.

Rom the Spaceknight has arrived in the Big Apple in search of his hated enemies the Dire Wraiths. However, the sinister shape-shifting aliens use man's natural xenophobia to turn them against the hero of Galador. Power Man and Iron Fist arrive on the seen to stop the rampaging alien they've been hearing about. Have the Dire Wraiths succeeded? Will our unsuspecting heroes destroy the very being who has come to our planet to save us?

The Ninja have been successfully stealing all pieces of amulets worn by the Sons of Tiger in order to bring the Jade Tiger to life!

A Shadowy warrior takes down one of Danny's closest friends, and when the Heroes for Hire confront the man responsible they wind up somewhere they never expected to be.

In pursuit of the deadly sorcerer Master Khan, Power Man and Iron Fist find themselves in the magical land of K'un Lun. Now, they have to survive long enough to defeat their sinister adversary and finds a way back home.

Note: This issue contains the Hostess Superhero Ad, The Thing in "A Lesson To Be Learned"!

Luke and Danny star in two separate adventures. First, Iron Fist survives an assassination attempt only to come face-to-face with the man called Warhawk. Guest-starring the Daughters of the Dragon. Story by Mike Barr and Chris Claremont. Art by Rudy Hebres, Frank Miller, and Ricardo Villamonte. Then, find out if a vampire bite can penetrate Power Man's diamond-hard skin in "The Vampire Strikes Back!" Story by Mary Jo Duffy. Art by Mark Bright and Ricardo Villamonte.

issue_title: What's Black and White and Red all over?
description:
Power Man and Iron Fist work as the bodyguards to Elyena, the injured ballerina who is on the hunt from Russian dancing-duo Ninotchka and Boris!

Story continued from Daredevil #178. A cry for help puts Power Man, Iron Fist, and the protector of Hell's Kitchen, Daredevil, in direct conflict with the lumbering bruiser Boris and the graceful femme fatal Ninotchka, and they give the heroes all they can handle.

Power Man, Iron Fist, Misty Knight, and Colleen Wing build a team to capture the Slasher, who has been terrorizing the city with his crime streaks.

The modern day Robin Hood, El Aguila, is back and he may wish he had stayed away. There's a killer stalking the streets of New York City and his identity is unknown. Here's a hint, he's one of the deadliest men alive. For the reveal of his identity see Power Man and Iron Fist #84.

Art imitates life in this strange, (and theatrical), issue!

When a pack of robots go berserk, it's up to the Heroes for Hire to stop them before someone gets hurt.

Power Man and Iron Fist are hired by the offices of Murphy Merriam Fontaine to track down a robber responsible for break-ins.

Montenegro is back and he's taken a young girl hostage. Now, it's up to Power Man and Iron Fist stop this elusive foe. But that is easier said than done.

Power Man and Iron Fist head to Halwan, where Abe Brown is under fire for crimes he has no memory of committing.

The lumbering bruiser Boris and the graceful femme fatal Ninotchka are back. Power Man and Iron Fist find themselves between a rock and hard place when their erstwhile adversaries show up.

Power Man and Iron Fist are trapped in the Royal Palace of Halwan, where there's a fight around every corner!

A pit of deadly spikes at their backs and a cadre of killer assassins in front, the Heroes for Hire have the bad guys right where they want them.

Warhawk is once again loose on the streets, attacking Asian citizens in his twisted way of getting back at the Vietnamese. Power Man and Iron Fist take care of the menace once and for all!

The merc known as Warhawk has just beat Iron Fist unconscious. Now you know this is only going to brass off Luke Cage.

Notes:

  • The cover is a homage of the cover of Baffling Mysteries #7.

In a revenge plan gone wrong, Sabretooth ends up attaching Harmony instead of Misty Knight, leaving her with some serious injuries! Luke is out to avenge Harmony, and Iron Fist is right there with him!

At last the identity of Slasher (a serial killer from Power Man and Iron Fist #78) is revealed. Power Man and Iron Fist are in the fight of their lives against the life-crushing coils of the Constrictor and Sabretooth, one of the deadliest men alive.

The Heroes for Hire investigate a trucker route where drivers keep mysteriously disappearing.

Henry Pratt's delivery trucks along with their drivers are disappearing at an alarming rate and the workers are becoming scared and restless. He calls in the Heroes for Hire, Power Man and Iron Fist, to investigate the problem. Can diamond-hard fist and kung-fu possibly defeat a foe who has battled the Fantastic Four to a stand-still. It's Power Man and Iron Fist vs. the Mole Man. Of course they can.....with ease

Power Man and Iron Fist become the body guards to the turbulent rock star Rip Chord!

Somebody wants a rock-n-roll band dead. Now, it's up to the Heroes for Hire to keep these young rockers alive as their super-train rockets through a danger infested mountain pass

When Moon Knight gets himself stuck in a bad situation, his colleagues Frenchie and Marlene hire Power Man and Iron Fist to find him! Through investigation, the Heroes for Hire track him down, but not without a fight from Commodore Planet!

Moon Knight drops down to the street and chases a man involved with a terrorist organization. The man leads Moon Knight to an open water tower and tries to shoot him. In the scuffle, both fall in and are knocked unconscious. Eighteen hours later, Marlene and Frenchie show up at Power Man and Iron Fist's door, asking for them to find him. Marlene would normally do it herself, but the recent death of her brother has her feeling incapable. Meanwhile, Moon Knight comes to, only to find he's sprained his knee, dislocated his shoulder, and may even have a concussion. To make matters worse, the city is having a record-breaking heatwave. Power Man and Iron Fist meet with Crawley on Frenchie's suggestion, and he tells them about a rendezvous at the Jersey piers. They wait at the pier and discover a meeting with a submarine. They break up the meet but Commodore Planet manages to escape. Marc remembers the man he was chasing (who is now dead) and finds he has a crow bar. Thinking there is a way out, Marc only discovers a hidden hatch and bags of money. Suddenly, a downpour strikes and Marc's tank begins filling with water. Meanwhile, back at their office, Luke and Danny are visited by the terrorist's wife, who gives them a clue as to Moon Knight's whereabouts. Too weak to swim, Marc manages to stay afloat with the money bags just long enough to be rescued.

The new designer drug Acid Z is the hottest craze at the Gem theater, but its side effects are deadly. Power Man and Iron Fist split up to crush the drug problem from the source!

Villains from Danny and Luke's past resurface and unite. Can Power Man and Iron Fist stand against Black Mariah (last seen in #5) and the deadly man known as Scimitar

What was criminal mercenary Hosiah Hawkins' last dying wish to his team of soldiers? Kill Power Man and Iron Fist!

How can Power Man and Iron Fist hope to take down a group of rogue soldiers who are willing to die rather than be taken alive?

When former supervillain Unus the Untouchable shifts to petty crimes against small businesses, Power Man and Iron Fist are forced to take down his impenetrable force fields!

The mutant terrorist known as Unus the Untouchable is causing a disturbance in the neighborhood of the Heroes for Hire. How can Power Man and Iron Fist hope to take down an opponent they can't even lay a hand on?

Hired for the same job, Power Man and Iron Fist are pitted against Vienna, a master spy! Will the Heroes for Hire be able to get their paycheck when Vienna seems to always be one-step ahead?

Power Man and Iron fist are trying to bust up a ring of smugglers. The only problem is a sassy spy keeps beating them to the punch. Can the Heroes for Hire get one up on this sneaky secret agent, or will their payday forever be just out of reach?

Maggia criminal Hammerhead is finally going behind bars. What Power Man and Iron Fist thought would be an easy job soon proves difficult when Hammerhead’s schemes come into play!

As the dangerous villain known as Hammer Head is transported to prison, the Heroes for Hire ride "shotgun." First, Luke Cage and his partner, Iron Fist, must face Man Mountain Marko and the electrical shocks of the Eel. Then, will they have enough left over to stop Hammer Head from escaping?

A villainous return! After Luke happens upon a robbery led by his old friend Mingo, Power Man and Iron Fist stops Mingo’s next heist and finds out who ordered them—Chemistro!

The villainous Chemistro is back and this time not even Luke Cage's diamond-hard skin will save him. Luckily, he has Danny Rand and the power of the Iron Fist on his side.

With Bob Diamond and Colleen Wing turned into glass statues, Power Man and Iron Fist must find a way to defeat Chemistro and save their friends from a shattering fate!

The villain Chemistro has just turned Bob and Colleen into statues made of glass. Now, you know this is only going to brass-off Luke Cage. Can Power Man and Iron Fist find a way to save their friends before they are shattered into a million pieces.

In the midst of celebrating their victory against Chemistro, Iron Fist’s fist draws him and Power Man towards a mysterious island…

Danny Rand comes into contact with a giant gem that causes his Iron Fist to react in a way he is not used to. Could this gem have something to do with Shao-Lao the Undying, the dragon Danny received his special abilities from?

Back in action, the now-confident Chemistro uses his alchemy gun for evil once again! With the help of Curtis Carr, Power Man and Iron Fist face their foe!

The Heroes for Hire pit their skills against the substance altering-abilities of Chemistro. What good are diamond-hard fist and kung fu against a guy who can turn steel into glass?

As Power Man packs up the office in Times Square, Iron Fist must defend his newly purchased Power Gem of Quon!

A savage new villain from Danny's homeland of K'un Lun comes searching for the martial arts master.

Equipped with new weapons, Power Man’s old foes Shades and Comanche attack him in the middle of the street! With Iron Fist’s help, will Power Man be able to retaliate against Shades and Comanche?

Shade and Comanche, adversaries from Luke Cages past, have returned to take down the so called Power Man. And this time they just may have the power to do it.

Fera is back with a mission to kill! With the incriminating documentary footage of Ward Meachum still in Power Man and Iron Fist’s possession, Fera attacks them along with Colleen Wing and old ally El Aguila!

Luke and Danny wash up to shore totally defeated. Meanwhile, Misty Knight, Colleen Wing, and El Aguila fight for their lives against a cadre of armed guards and the savage attack of Fera.

Before he was the macabre Moon Knight, he was mercenary Marc Spector. Witness the origin of the hero known as Moon Knight! Cloaked in the spirit of the Egyptian moon god, Moon Knight swears vengeance on “Bushman”, the mercenary who takes innocent lives and leaves his colleagues for dead.

The mercenary Marc Spector defies his employer Bushman, and is left in the desert to die. He stumbles upon the archaeological dig of Marlene Alraune and dies from dehydration and exhaustion. He is placed before the statue of Khonshu and miraculously comes back to life. He believes that the ancient Egyptian god has given him back his life so that he can become his avatar of justice among living mortals. Spector goes back into town to confront Bushman but he escapes. Spector dons the guise of Moon Knight and begins his new life as a superhero. It isn't long before Bushman finds him in his new life and Moon Knight has to fight him once more. If not for Marlene, Spector's love interest, he would have killed Bushman but instead leaves him for the authorities to take care of.

The Midnight Man destroys Spector’s most prized possession. Can Moon Knight prove his mettle with or without the spirit of Khonshu? The Bushman’s final demise.

Moon Knight's evening started with him chasing Midnight Man into the sewers to rescue his butler Samuels and retrieve the Khonshu statue he believed held his power. Ambushed by Bushman, he gets trapped in a sealed room filling quickly with water. He narrowly gets himself, Samuels and Midnight Man out but his statue is broken. Feeling powerless he gives up...Crawley and marlene hunt him down, bring him home, clean him up and show that his statue is still in one piece. The broken statue was a fake. reenergized Moon Knight heads into the night and captures Bushman for the authorities.

A ghost from Frenchie’s past reemerges. But what are Isabelle Kristel’s ties to Cajun Creed? The investigation leads Moon Knight to New Orleans, where a drug trafficking ring is threatening New York. Will the shadow of Khonshu clean-up the streets?

Moon Knight is on the trail of Cajun Creed, a drug trafficker from New Orleans trying to make moves into New York. Isabelle Kristel, Frenchie(marks pilot)'s one true love, drops in...and ends up murdered a few days later. The answers to her death lead to New Orleans and Cajun Creed himself. Will Moon Knight be able to avenger Isabelle's murder or is Cajun just too spicy for him to handle?

Marlene’s brother Dr. Peter Alraune is in grave danger! After a patient experiences terrifying side effects, Moon Knight must save the doctor from his own medicine. Enter Morpheus, dripping fangs and all.

Dr. Peter Alraune, Marlene's brother, is the victim of a vicious attack from one of his patients, who has had a rather peculiar reaction to his treatment. Can Moon Knight stop the menacing Morpheus before he can finish off Marlene's brother?

Co-starring Daredevil! Two shadowy vigilantes, hot on the trail of The Jester. But why? Witness Moon Knight and Daredevil in their very first team-up!

The Jester is out on the loose intent on revenge...meanwhile Moon Knight and Daredevil are also hot on his heels. Can these two crime fighters work together or will their own agendas get in the way and lead to a confrontation?

This is the first team up between Moon Knight and Daredevil.

Moon Knight runs afoul of a criminal mastermind…and his mother! Scarlet Fasinera will stop at nothing to protect her son. Will Moon Knight be able to deliver justice before this mother with a mission beats him to the punch?

Joe "Mad Dog" Fasinera has escaped prison and is on the loose causing havoc. Moon Knight jumps on the case and comes across Scarlet Fasinera, his mother, who is trying to save her son. Can she save a murderer or will Moon Knight inact his own justiice.

issue_title: Ruling The World From His Basement
description:
Moon Knight- assassin? Marc Spector’s morality becomes even more blurry when Xenos and his army of rats enter the fray!

Moon Knight turned assassin!!! Is it true? Has Moon Knight become an assassin...and just who is Xenos? What part does he have to play in this mystery?

issue_title: Shadows of the Moon; Seekers of Stone
description:
The Thing guest-stars! Ben Grimm and Moon Knight combine forces to complete a little boy’s vendetta. Plus, Moon Knight is hired to steal the head of Medusa! Will the merc get caught in her stony gaze?

Shadows of the Moon

Detective Mills is gunned down and his son wants to get the men who did it...who better to help out a little kid then Ben Grimm, a.k.a. Thing, and Moon Knight.

Spector: Mercenary! The Man Who Would Become Moon Knight! Seekers of Stone

Spector is hired to steal a box containing the Head of Medusa. What trouble could he possible get into?

issue_title: Master Sniper's Legacy; Worship of False Idols
description:
Marc Spector endures tragedy when a longtime friend is murdered in front of him. But Moon Knight will exact revenge! Moon Knight vs. The Master Sniper and his gang of hired guns.

Master Sniper's Legacy

The Master Sniper kills one of Marc Spector's long time spy friends in front of his own eyes. Now angered and looking for revenge, Moon Knight takes on Nimrod Strange, Master Sniper and his whole gang of Third World Slayers.

Worship of False Idols

Marc endures great peril and hardship to recover a extremely "valuable" Incan statue.

Moon Knight must thwart attacks from all sides after Nimrod Strange unleashes his three best assassins. But will they best Moon Knight? The Third World Slayers have no idea what’s coming for them!

Moon Knight is still on the trail of the Third World Slayers. Nimrod Strange is not pleased and has sent his three best assassins after Moon Knight...will they succeed?

Marlene goes undercover as one of Nimrod Strange’s bodyguards, while Moon Knight infiltrates his island base. Has Moon Knight resigned Marlene to a fate worse than death? Arsenal shows up, leaving Moon Knight in explosive straits!

Moon Knight infiltrates Nimrod Strange's island base but runs into....Arsenal??? Can Moon Knight defeat this one man army or has he seen his last moon rise? Marlene Alraune infiltrates as one of Nimrod's females bodyguards. Moon Knight explodes the Island with Arsenal's planes, but the villain manages to escape with Marlene.

In the dark alleys of New York, Moon Knight hunts for the “Skid Row Slasher.” Later, Spector takes on the guise of sophisticated Steven Grant, and attempts to find information about the killer from a newspaper publisher.

Moon Knight must hunt down and stop The Slasher, a maniac who has been killing the homeless. Crawley is almost killed by the maniac but escapes with his life. He can't help but feel he recognizes the killer. Moon Knight, in the guise of Jake Lockley/Steven Grant, shares his secret identities and enlists the help of Gena Landers, Ray Landers, Ricky Landers and Crawley to help him hunt down the Slasher. He succeeds in capturing the killer with Crawley alongside as a witness. Afterwards, Crawley remembers why the face looks so familiar and breaks down inside. At the court trial Crawley claims he saw nothing. When confronted as to why he is changing his story he confesses that he cannot help convict his own son. Upon hearing this, the Slasher erupts in insane anger, steals a bailiff's gun and chases after Crawley. Moon Knight catches up to him on the roof and tries to get the killer to drop the gun, but as he is trying to talk him down he is slowly backing up. The Slasher continues to back up until he falls off the roof to his death.

issue_title: Cut Adrift Off the Coast of America
description:
The climactic conclusion to Moon Knight vs. Arsenal! All looks lost, as Moon Knight is captured by Arsenal and his Third World Slayers. Luckily, a turn of events is in order. Will Arsenal’s ‘Manhattan Plan’ come to fruition? If it does, all of New York City will be up in flames!

The climatic conclusion to Arsenal and the Third World Slayers. Moon Knight has followed Arsenal back to New York, Manhattan to be precise, and discovers his "Manhatten Plan". Can Moon Knight stop the terrorist before he unleashes Armageddon upon New York?

Moon Knight sneaks into one of Arsenal's ship where the chemical gases are and release it into the air. Then Moon Knight is captured by Arsenal personal guard and tied up. When he manages to escape using one of his moon blades, Marlene was coming to help him and they both fight against Arsenal and his bodyguards.

At the end Moon Knight succeeds on stopping Arsenal's plan of exploding New York, but the bad guy kills himself with his bombs.

issue_title: The Master Of Night Earth / Murder By Moonlight
description:
The God of Vengeance sinks his teeth into a worthy victim. Will Moon Knight be able to uphold his divine obligation to Khonshu? You bet! Plus, a zombie spook fest featuring Brother Voodoo!

The Master of Night Earth

Moon Knight comes face to face with real life zombies. He signed up to help prevent a revolution...now he has to deal with the 'Grand Bois' and his army of the undead. Can Moon Knight make it out alive...and just who is Brother Voodoo?

Murder by Moonlight

Herb Russell, a common thief and now cop killer, is on the run from the police. The museum seems as good a place as any to hide out...but Russell better beware of Khonshu, Egyptian God of Vengeance.

issue_title: The Dream Demon; Moon Over Alamein
description:
Has Marc Spector finally cracked? After visiting Morpheus, Moon Knight finds himself haunted by a mysterious figure in black. Is this mere hallucination or something far more sinister?

The Dream Demon

Moon Knight checks up on Morpheus to see that all is well. Weird things begin to happen...a strange figure in black keeps trying to kill Moon Knight....Moon Knight keeps hallucinating...Is Morpheus to blame?

Moon Over Alamein

The Allied Forces are in Africa planning their assault on Rommel's tank division. The way is treacherous and pocked with land mines...will Khonshu give his aid to the allies or let the Axis be triumphant?

Night-stalker Morpheus has finally caught up to Moon Knight at his mansion in Maine. Are Marlene and Frenchie in danger too? And is this a battle for Moon Knight…or Steven Grant?

Morpheus has tracked Moon Knight, Marlene, Frenchie and Peter to Steven Grant's Maine mansion. Revenge is setting heavily on the night and before the sun rises there will be death to reckon with.

Scarlet acts as a free agent to dissemble the mob’s grip over the city…and Moon Knight is hard-pressed to stop her.

Scarlet Fasinera is back...this time she is on a mission. Mob heads are dieing left and right and Scarlet is to blame. Can Moon Knight stop her from killing again...or better yet, does he want to?

A new vigilante rises as he spins out of a mental breakdown…and his primary target is Khonshu’s avatar!

Prologue

Carson Knowles returns from the Vietnam War to find his wife gone with his child. He then learns that they've replaced him at his day job, and is rejected by every new one he applies for (including his father's old political associate, Mr Cranston). Finally, he gets a job as a courier. A few years later, the hits keep coming as he learns that his estranged son has been killed in a gang fight. Then, 5 years on, his car--and source of income--gets stripped in a bad neighbourhood, and that's the final straw. A mugger appears, asking for Carson's wallet, and he snaps, beating him to unconsciousness. He later learns of Moon Knight's rise to from mercenary to hero in a magazine article and decides to model his new life on him... only in reverse. He recruits some thugs and makes his appearance as BLACK SPECTRE.

Part I: First Clash

Moon Knight takes off with Frenchie on their nightly rounds, despite Marlene saying she needs to speak with him about something. Meanwhile, Black Spectre breaks into Cranston's office and threatens him to vote for Carson Knowles in the upcoming mayoral election. Refusing, Black Spectre beats him up and trashes his office. Moon Knight arrives, but is easily beaten, much to his confusion. He does, however, get a look at Black Spectre's face. Detective Flint shows up, but Cranston refuses to talk. Back at his home, Marc anguishes over his defeat. Marlene tries to talk to him, but is again ignored. Later, Carson makes an appearance on TV, and Marc sees his face, realising he's Black Spectre. He races out, speaks briefly to Crawley, and knows he has to stop him. Arriving at Cranston's office, he overhears him talking to Gus Chiodo, saying Black Spectre is coming for him, which turns out to be true. Chiodo refuses to vote for Cranston and when Marc arrives, finds him hanging dead from some chains. That night, Marlene finally tells Marc she's leaving.

Part II: Sinking

Marc tries to convince Marlene to stay, but she's made up her mind. He does ask for her help, though, to infiltrate Carson's campaign, which she agrees to do as one last thing. Marc also asks Frenchie to find Crawley and ask what he's learned of Carson. Little does he know that Carson's thugs frequent the bar and they attack Frenchie, leaving him in hospital. Having accessed Carson's campaign--as his personal assistant no less--Marlene tells Marc that he's wrong, that Carson is a good man who wants to change the city. Thinking he can play Carson's own game, Moon Knight calls a press conference to try to out Carson as Black Spectre, but the press don't buy it and end up turning on him. Carson sees the broadcast and calls in a favour from the police chief. Upon leaving the conference, Moon Knight is shot at by police. He fights them off, but it shot in the shoulder in the process. He returns home to find Marlene leaving, disgusted at his stunt.

Part III: The Climb Back

Moon Knight pleads to Khonshu to give him the strength to defeat Carson. Meanwhile, Carson's about to speak to the people, and they are chanting his name. He knows it's a sure thing. Going up to the roof for a better view of his adoring crowd, Marlene stays behind, finding his budget plans and finally learning of Carson's plans to take over the city. Up on the roof, Moon Knight appears, but doesn't see Carson, giving him time to change into Black Spectre. They fight, and Moon Knight gets stabbed by his sword. Black Spectre thinks himself victorious and leaves. However, Moon Knight stumbles to his feet and attacks, pushing Black Spectre out the window. They both land in a search light below, and Moon Knight pulls off Black Spectre's mask to reveal it's Carson. Flint is there, and says it doesn't prove anything, but then Marlene shows up with the budget plans.

A ruthless hit man is bombing cabs at random…which means Jake Lockley will have to keep his eyes and ears open.

Hit It!

Moon Knight tracks down a man who is punching every person he meets. It turns out that the man was hit by his father as a child and is frustrated that he was never able to "pay him back".

The Cabbie Killer

Someone is blowing up taxis with a bazooka and Jake Lockley almost became a victim of such an attack. Moon Knight tracks down the assassin, Commodore Planet.

An anti-hero cop starts taking out corrupt members of his own force…leaving Moon Knight in a sticky moral predicament.

Jake Lockley is talking to a cop friend of his about the cop killer one night. When the man leaves, Jake hears a gunshot, but reaches the man too late. Moon Knight decides to investigate the case and breaks into the police station to see what info they already have. He is interrupted by a detective. He learns that the men were working for Kingpin so faces him for questions. Kingpin tells him that if he had cops working for him, why would he kill them. Later, two more cops are killed, but Moon Knight arrives just too late and the killer gets away. Moon Knight believes one of the detectives is the killer, but pegs the wrong one, making him a target. He figures it out in time and arrives to save the day.

Note: Back cover in black and white by Bill Sienkiewicz.

Marc and Marlene return to the birthplace of Moon Knight…the Sudanese desert. There, they must protect Lord Khonshu’s priceless relics from grave robbers!

Moon Knight is beating up some thugs when Marlene calls him and invites him to Sudan with her for a conference. He needs a break, so accepts. When they arrive, they are put up in a room but Marlene is attacked. Marc chases the attacker down the street but loses him. He returns to find Marlene missing, with a cryptic "K" painted on the wall in blood. He believes it to mean "Khonshu" and travels to the temple of Seti where Marc was resurrected. Marlene is being held captive in hopes that her knowledge can lead her assailant to the hidden treasure of the temple. She says she doesn't know of any treasure, but they don't believe her. Moon Knight arrives and after setting of a booby trap, discover the hidden treasure room. With a bit of luck (or divine intervention), Moon Knight gets the upper hand and saves Marlene.

Moon Knight tries to track down the Werewolf by Night before he is abducted by a satanic cult!

This issue contains two stories.

Morning Star

In an Omaha, Nebraska, railyard, Jack Russell flees from three black-robed and hooded figures, and seeks refuge in a boxcar, as the full moon rises. The three reach the car, and the Werewolf snatches and kills one of them, as the train begins to roll. Unable to keep up, the two remaining stalkers go to the ticket seller demanding to know its destination. In Los Angeles, Schuyler Belial, who calls himself Morning Star, holds a satanic mass. When he once again can't produce the beast from hell he has for months promised his flock, they begin to file out in disgust. Later, he receives a call from his agent in Omaha, informing him of recent events, and that Russell is headed for New York City. Belial, and some of his followers, take his private jet to New York, confident that even if Russell jumps the train, their tracking equipment will find him. A month later, in New York, Jake Lockley enters Gena's Diner and receives the message that Detective Flint wants a meeting with Moon Knight. Later, atop the precinct roof, Flint passes a letter to Moon Knight from Russell, requesting a meeting at a secluded house in New Jersey before dusk. Despite Frenchie's speedy piloting, Moon Knight arrives after moonrise, finding another note from Jack. It's a warning to bar the door to the room in which he's locked himself, but just as Moon Knight reaches for the bar, the Werewolf erupts through the door. He stuns Moon Knight and leaps out a window. Moon Knight gives chase, but is hit in the head with a log and knocked out. The night passes, and in the morning, Moon Knight comes to and finds the again human Jack Russell, whom he transports to his mansion. Later, Russell tells Moon Knight, Marlene and Frenchie of the year-long chase he's led Belial's men on, including one capture and escape, and Moon Knight surmises they may have implanted a tracer in Russell's body. Moon Knight calls in a favor from a Dr. Lawson, requesting his presence and x-ray equipment. Dr. Lawson confirms there is a chip under Russell's scalp, but it is too late in the day to begin surgery, so the doctor is asked to return the following day. Jack is strapped down as dusk approaches, but when he transforms, the Werewolf snaps his bonds and threatens Moon Knight and Marlene.

Colloquy

With nearly all the residents and employees of the mansion on leave or away on business, Steven Grant sits and contemplates his multiple personalities. Having integrated his selves, he exorcises the violent ghost of Marc Spector.

On three consecutive nights, Moon Knight apprehends three criminals at the same time. As if that weren’t coincidence enough, each criminal has stolen a valuable item related to each other. Moon Knight vs. the Midnight Man!

Moon Knight is on the case of the Midnight Man, a cat burglar who has successfully stolen valuable antiques/relics for 23 consecutive nights and who has been taunting the police and Moon Knight via mail. With Crawley's help, Moon Knight discovers the Midnight Man is planning an ambush for him that evening. At one of Steven Grant's functions, he is approached with an offer for Marc Spector. He knows this is the bait for the ambush and gladly accepts it. He meets up and confronts Midnight Man at Anton Mogart's mansion, who is secretly the Midnight Man. They fight each other throughout the house and eventually end up on the roof where it looks like the Midnight Man gets the upper hand. Luckily for Moon Knight, Marlene shows up on the scene with a gun and shoots the Midnight Man before he can harm Moon Knight. He falls over the ledge of the roof to his death. As it turns out, Marlene's gun was filled with rubber bullets.

issue_title: The Moonwraith, Three Sixes, and a Beast
description:
Moon Knight mounts a rescue mission against the satanic cult that is holding Jack Russell hostage.

The Werewolf attacks Moon Knight, who orders Marlene Alraune to the basement for protection. The battle carries the two through a window to the Grant estate grounds. The Werewolf throws his foe against a tree, then runs for the city. Some time later, Moon Knight catches up with him on a rooftop, and the battle is joined anew. The man-beast lunges at Moon Knight, and their momentum carries them over the edge, into the alleyway below.

Both are unconscious and lay there till dawn, when Jack Russell, human again, and Moon Knight are captured by Schuyler Belial and his fellow satanists. Hours later, Belial, calling himself Morning Star, holds a gathering where he prepares to display his long-promised beast from hell. Russell and Moon Knight are chained up on the dais behind him, but many of the cultists present still doubt him. He promises proof when the moon rises and they will sacrifice a werewolf. Belial orders two of his lackeys to move the prisoners into a cage until sunset, but Moon Knight comes to, knocks out the pair, and contacts Frenchie over his cowl microphone. Soon, he and Russell are aboard and heading for Grant Mansion. Belial's men soon follow, homing on the signal from the chip implanted under Russell's scalp.
