At last - the landmark issue that laid the foundation for the future of the Valiant Universe, featuring the first appearance of Bloodshot! Guest-starring X-O Manowar, Archer, Shadowman, Toyo Harada, the Eternal Warrior and a cast of thousands, the next generation of Valiant heroes begins here! But just what is the Blood of Heroes? And how will it create a legacy that stretches from the modern day into the distant future?

Geoff, the Geomancer frees the hero known as Bloodshot from Project Rising Spirit. Years later, Shadowman dies to rid the world of the Darque Power! After that, the deaths of Archer, Aric and Bloodshot are all precursors to the great Harbinger Wars against Toyo Harada. During this struggle, the Blood of Heroes remains hidden. Finally, in 4002, Geomancer Rokland Tate bestows it upon Takao Konishi - the Last Rai!

This is a telling of the Rai history. It also gives us a detailed account of everything from The Unity Saga on up to the creation of Rai and The Future Force.

Along with that this issue serves as the origin story of Bloodshot.

Meet Takao Konishi, the last Rai! With the Blood of Heroes coursing through his veins, Rai will lead humanity's liberation from the all-knowing, all-powerful sentient nation known as Grandmother. But when you upset Grandmother, you must be punished.

Now that the Grandmother computer no longer rules Japan, the orbiting nation is split between the ruling Humanist party, and the Healers, who want to restore computer control. When the Healers attempt to steal a component from the Skull-dome control center, Rai and Kazuyo find themselves forced to battle a deadly Grandmother drone! But the terrible fight is only a diversion, designed to hide the Healers' true objective.

In this issue we meet Makiko Minashi a man who was raised from birth to be the protector of the people of Japan. He takes the title of Rai. He follows the teachings of Japans master computer called Grandmother. This makes it impossible for him to pick a side in the impending revolution.

Rai questions his leadership ability, but soon realizes that he must battle the Emperor and save all of humanity.

1st appearance:

- Mother Nike

Tokoa Konishi seeks council with Mother Nike, to debate on joining Magnus to North Am to fight Malev Emperor or stay and fight in Japan.
Rai and the Future Force must retreat after their failed assault on the Malevs. Will the heroes survive to fight another day?
Rai and the Future Force must defeat the Malevs -- mankind's mortal enemy. But when cyborg slavers attack, will our heroes be prepared?!

It seems that even nature is against Rai and the Future Force when they find themselves in the middle of the first full blown typhoon in a century! They are forced to take refuge in a strange land, but will they make new allies there or have to brave new threats?
The Malev Emperor is launching a new attack! Will Rai and the Future Force be able to fend the off and save their friends - or will they be too late?!

issue_title: The Battle For South Am-- Chapter One: One For All
description: Rai and the Future Force prepare for the Malev attack on North Am. Will the heroes be able to defeat this robotic menace?! And will Rai and Leeja's relationship finally be brought to light?

issue_title: The Battle For South Am-- Chapter Three: Targets
description: Something seems amiss as Rai and the Future Force investigate the Malev's plan. Could the Malev's plot be even worse than our heroes had anticipated?

Will squabbles between the members of the Future Force be enough to lead them astray? Or will they be able to overcome their differences to confront the Malev? And will they uncover the fate of Timbuc?
Rai and the Future Force stumble upon a 500 year old plantation whose workers are enslaved humans! How will the heroes deal with this horrendous reality?

Rai gets frostbite when Icespike strikes! Who is this mysterious new assassin and what has he sworn his life to protect? Only one thing is for sure… he wants Rai dead! Overwhelmed and outmatched by this vicious new foe, Rai must call on the unlikeliest of allies to win the day.

With many in Japan falling prey to Neo-plum addiction, Rai strikes at a facility producing the debilitating drug. But the task won't be easy, for the drug factory is guarded by Icespike, a super-assassin out to make his reputation by killing Rai. Rai and Kazuyo manage to beat him, but Icespike escapes capture. This defeat prompts the Healer leader, Councillor Seko, to make Rai's death his top priority.

In This issue, the followers of Grandma are angered at Rai for questioning her teachings at the end of issue #1. They end up hiring an assassin to kill the Rai, but soon regret it as he begins to attack any one or thing in order to complete his mission.
Death of Tekla.

1st appearance:
-  Psi Lords
-  Obadiah, Son of RAI & Leeja

Psi Lords - ship appear for the first time in Magnus # 36  - same month as RAI # 21.

4020 A.D. Obadiah Konishi, son of the 43rd Rai, and Takashi Nakadai, son of the 42nd have grown up side by side, sometimes friends, usually rivals. As they vie for the legacy of the Spirit Guardian of Japan, will their enmity turn deadly?

1st appearance:

- Suki Seko

The young Obadiah receives a mysterious message leading him on a quest to find Spylocke and the Blood of Heroes. Will he survive the journey? Or will Takashi's treachery allow him to steal the legacy of Rai?

The Chaos Effect threatens the 41st century, will Obadiah survive Spylocke's training and gain the powers of his father in time to help? And to what lengths will his rival Takashi go to take the title of Rai for himself?

Chaos Effect - Epsilon, Part 3.

Continued from Psi Lords # 3.

Takashi Nakadai gets X-O Commando Armor.

Death of Kazuyo Nakadai (Mother of Takashi).

The time has come for Obadia Konishi to claim his father's legacy and become Rai! But is he too late to save Japan from the usurper Takashi Nakadai, the self-proclaimed 43rd Rai, armed with his mother's stolen X-O Commando armor?

Obadiah returns from Africa armed for the final showdown with his foster brother the self-proclaimed usurper to the title of Rai! Will the Obadiah Konishi be able to use the newly gained power of the Blood of Heroes to defeat the might of Takashi Nakadai's X-O Commando armor and claim his rightful place as spirit guardian of Japan?

The newly minted Rai travels to the Temple of Archer in Ladakh and discovers there a sinister enemy hidden away. He'll also find an unexpected ally- Rentaro Nakadai, the one time 41st Rai and the only man alive to have once held the title, and grandfather of Takashi Nakadai, the new Rai's bitterest enemy!

The time for games is over, as Rai brings his war, to the Japanese government's front door! But with the home field advantage, Grandmother sends Rai into the belly of the beast -- literally! It's Rai versus a gargantuan metal monster -- place your bets!

Out to rid themselves of Rai, their greatest enemy, the Humanists sabotage Japan's Nerveweb. Rai attempts to travel through the web, only to find himself trapped within, facing an electronic monster! Meanwhile, Kazuyo is attacked by Healer assassin, Makiko. Kazuyo bests Makiko, even as Rai escapes from the Nerveweb trap. But Rai is losing favor with the people of Japan, and the Healers couldn't be happier about it!

In this issue we find that some of the Proclaimers advisors have told him he should cut his ties with the Rai, thanks to Rai's waining popularity. At the same time the Humanists try and make their move to kill Rai and his wife who is the owner of some X-O Armor.

A beautiful but deadly woman who has come to Ladakh seeking revenge for her fallen brother befriends the young Obadiag. But will she be able to complete her lethal mission when she learns the young Rai is also her chosen target?

The new Rai is still learning the full extent of the secrets held locked inside him by the Blood of Heroes. But something goes deadly wrong when he explores the records of the long ago death of Bloodshot at the hands of the technopath Harbinger called Ax.

The mind of the 21st century technopathic Harbinger called Ax has taken over the new Rai! What secrets does the two thousand years dormant villain hold? And can Spylocke keep him from using them to wrest control of Blood of Heroes and the world with it?

Rai, Spylocke, Rentaro assault Takashi's undersea robot factory. Will any one of them walk away alive from this subsurface showdown?

Final issue.

Story continues in Magnus # 49.

The humanists launch a full-frontal assault against the healers! But without out the aid of Rai, are they walking into a slaughter? Meanwhile, Rai has a conversation with his father that will forever change the course of his life. It's revenge and reckonings in this status quo-shattering issue!

The Healers are about to launch a special rocket that will end Humanist control over Japan. Kazuyo leads government troops in an attack on the launch site, only to find Makiko waiting in her own battle-armor! Rai arrives in time to help Kazuyo beat Makiko, but the resulting battle knocks the Healer missile off-course. Thousands die as the projectile hits Japan, and Rai is dismayed to find that the people blame him for the carnage!

In this issue the followers of Grandma make a last ditch effort to bring the Grandmother Computer back to Japan. Rai goes against his teachings and mission to stop the followers from hurting any more of the Japanese, and he joins his wife in stopping them.

Exiled! As a result of the politics of war Rai is forced to leave Japan with his son. Adrift in space, can Rai make it to Earth?

Exiled from Japan, Rai and his infant son fly to Earth on a shuttle. But a Healer leader has rigged the craft to fly out of control into space! He then assassinates the President and has Kazuyo captured, her ring-hand severed so she cannot summon her armor! Meanwhile, Rai uses the energy in his body to power his shuttle-craft down to Earth. Rising from the wreck with his son, Rai finds Rokkie and Gilad waiting to take him to Unity!

1st appearance:

- Rokland Tate

issue_title: Unity Chapter 7: A World Brought Down
description:
With the very fate of Japan hanging in the balance, The Eternal Warrior of the 41st Century recruits Rai into a fight to save time itself.

Unity Chapter 7

Rokkie, Gilad, and Rai go to North Am to recruit Magnus' aid in the Unity Conflict. The heroes proceed to battle Mothergod in the Lost Land. But Mothergod can sense the incredible energies within Rai, making him a great threat to her plans. So, she informs Rai that unless he leaves the Lost Land, she will make Japan crash back to Earth. Knowing that he must stay, Rai is forced to watch as is nation falls to its death!

With Japan in ruins, Rai must fight alone to save existence itself!

Unity Chapter 15

Knowing Mothergod has destroyed Japan, Rai now lives only for vengeance! His chance comes when the heroes make an assault on the citadel of Mothergod to free the captive Solar. Rai holds her off while the others search for Solar. Their desperate combat unleashes awesome energies! But in the end, Rai dies at Mothergod's hands, not knowing that his sacrifice made it possible for Solar to be freed and the Unity War won.

Vengeance for the Dead: the war beyond time is over, the threat defeated. But what of the fate of Japan?! It's all out war in the ruins of the great city.

Held captive by Counselr Seko's Healer forces, Kazuyo finds herself freed when Japan crashes back to Earth. Believing her son and husband dead, Kazuyo seeks revenge! Kazuyo recovers her severed ring-hand from the wreckage and summons her armor, slaying Seko after defeating his bodyguard, Icespike. With the fighting over, Kazuyo is relieved to learn that her son still lives.

The team holds off the Malev Robots and forces them to retreat. Rai unites the Future Force to preserve humanity's future.

1st "Rai and the Future Force"

Variant Cover: Gold Logo (see pic below)

Tokoa Konishi 2nd appearance. Tokoa is joined by Magnus and others to fight the Malev forces in Japan.

North Am, 4001 A.D. A gang of rogue Freewill robots, led by O-1X. attacks Centralrob. Suddenly, Magnus is among them, destroying the Freewills with deadly precision! O-1X escapes, and later attacks 1-A in Magnus' undersea base. Magnus knows he has his hands full with O-1X's rebellion, and now he learns that there are an estimated ten million Freewills hidden among North Am's robot-servant population!

Freewill robots learn that there are others like them and start communicating with each other and try to organize and Magnus wonders whether these freewill robots are truly alive and not merely machines in “Steel Nation Part One -- Protector.” Story also includes the origin of 1-A.

At his undersea base, 1-A recounts how he raised Magnus from infancy to protect humans from rogue Freewill robots. Suddenly, a broadcast from rogue leader O-1X implores Freewills to unite. Magnus rushes back to North Am and, with Leeja at his side, hunts down the Freewill secret headquarters. In the battle that follows, Leeja is seriously injured, and Magnus begins to doubt the morality of his war on the Freewills.

Notes:

  • 1st Valiant superhero comic, Magnus was originally a Gold Key title (1960's).
  • First issue in the Valiant series.
  • Contains three Valiant Trading Cards and one of eight coupons for Magnus #0.

issue_title: The Xyrkol Trilogy Part 2: Freedom's End
description:
Afraid of Synchron and as North Am is helpless without power, President Clane decides to take desperate measures and has Xyrkol’s mind freed from the pycho probe in order to get him to help North Am defend itself. But Xyrkol, of course, plays by his own agenda in “The Xyrkol Trilogy Part Two – Freedom’s End.”

As Magnus is about to be psycho-probed, the Freewills of Synchron retaliate against North Am with a nuclear missile strike. The explosions knock out North Am's power, and Magnus escapes in the confusion. Desperate, President Clane turns to criminal genius Xyrkol for a means to strike back. Instead of helping Clane, Xyrkol uses his new power to subdue Magnus and prepare to conquer chaos-stricken North Am!

issue_title: The Xyrkol Trilogy Part 3: Sun Of The Devil
description:
With Magnus imprisoned by Xyrkol and North Am and Synchron helpless, it’s up to Leeja to infiltrate Xyrkol’s stronghold and stop him in “The Xyrkol Trilogy Part Three – Sun of the Devil.”

Demonstrating his power, Xyrkol boils away North Am's largest lake! President Clane surrenders to Xyrkol, but Synchron fights on! Leeja sneaks into Xyrkol's fortress and frees the captive Magnus. Together, they transport the fortress to the Goph lev, where Tekla takes Xyrkol into custody before the Gophs can tear him to pieces! With new inner strength, Leeja returns home.

issue_title: Stone And Steel  /  Trial And Error
description:
Magnus is asked by Willow Talltrees to come to the Lost Land, where the settlement founded by her and Lazlo Noel is under attack by savages. Magnus goes only to discover that the savages, led by Turok, are in the right! Throwing in with Turok, Magnus helps bring about the defeat of Noel, who winds up trapped within a disabled robot dinosaur. Magnus and Turok part as friends, and then it's back to North Am!

1st. appearances:

- Turok

- Andar

- Lost Land

- Dr. Noel

- Willow Talltrees

Magnus is taken to 1-A’s lair and has to deal with the problems and escapees of the asylum of 1-A’s past mutated failures of his attempts to create a robot fighter in “The Asylum Saga Part One -- Revelations.”

Returning to North Am, Magnus battles a creature from 1-A's asylum on Phobos. Taken aboard the creature's ship, he learns of 1-A's original Robot Fighter candidates who have been locked away in the Asylum. Convinced by Asylum inmates, Frost, Fluffy, and Magskrag, that the others are wrongly imprisoned, Magnus takes their ship to Phobos to free those still trapped in the Asylum.

Magnus journeys to the Martian Moon Phobos to deal with the asylum that 1-A created to house the mutated failures in his attempts to generate a robot fighter in “The Asylum Saga Part Two -- Reckonings.”

Magnus arrives at the Asylum on Phobos and meets inmates Izak and Chuh-chuck, who revere him as their ideal hero. However, Grand-One is also there, intent upon eliminating the failed Robot Fighters by flooding the Asylum with poison gas! Forced to battle Grand-One, Magnus kills the very robot that raised him! Saddened by this tragic battle, Magnus decides to look after the inmates, but knows they are too dangerous to set free.

Death of Grand One.

1st appearance:

- Izak

issue_title: Unity Chapter 4: The Torch Is Passed
description: Geomancer Rokland Tate must find the Eternal Warrior, who, due to psycho-probing, doesn't even know who he is. When he finally restores Gilad's memories, Rokkie and the Warrior go to summon Rai's help for the coming Unity Conflict. Meanwhile, Mothergod has transported the North Am city of San Gabriel to the Lost Land. Magnus goes to investigate, only to face the menace of the indestructible robot, Talpa!

Magnus is pulled away from his battle with Talpa to join Rokkie, Rai, and Gilad in the Unity Conflict. The fighting begins immeadiately and continues through the months the heroes spend in the wondrous Lost Land. But Magnus's most amazing experience hasn't anything to do with fighting. For, when he cradles Kris Hathaway's newborn child in his mighty arms, Magnus unknowingly holds the baby who will grow up to be him!

WOW!

Birth of Magnus Robot Fighter...

(Yes, it's true)

Mother is Kris Hathaway, Father is Torque.

Talpha, an old enemy of Magnus, destroys buildings in North Am and threatens to keep doing so until Magnus is delivered to him. But when Magnus is found, he has just returned from the Unity sage and is no condition to fight. So Leeja has to come up with a plan in “Trouble Below.”

Bent on the destruction of Magnus, Talpa wreaks havoc upon North Am! But the Robot Fighter is in no shape to face Talpa, having just returned from the Unity Conflict. In response to Talpa's demands that Magnus be turned over to him, Leeja tells the robot to return to San Gabriel. Now recuperated, Magnus fights Talpa, alternately exposing the robot to extreme heat and cold, making it brittle enough to smash!

In need of money, Magnus is forced to work for Elzy’s goph salvage and reconstruction yard while E7 and A9 of Synchron meet with Magnus’ old foe Mekman in “Inside the Metal Mind.”

After stopping Elzy from kidnapping Willow Talltrees, Magnus agrees to work at salvage with the fiesty Goph. Meanwhile, Freewill Robot, E7, meets with the robot-worshipping villain, Mekman, to determine if normal robots can be made into Freewills. But Mekman's psycho-probing prevents him from helping E7. Now E7 begins to wonder if he can work around his psycho-probing or remove Mekman's inhibitions entirely!

1st. appearances:

- Mekman

A9 and E7’s plans for Mekman to induce freewill in all robots begins and Magnus’ job with Elzy’s goph salvage and reconstruction yard has a lot more problems than he expected in “Probes.”

E7 allows Mekman to study his robot brain, hoping to find a way to make all robots Freewill. But Mekman cannot do so due to his anti-criminal conditioning, so he turns himself in. Later, Magnus goes to free Elzy from trouble with North Am Security, only to find E7 rescuing Mekman from more psycho-probing! Magnus liberates Elzy and reports E7 to Freewill leader, Tekla, leaving Mekman to psycho-probe himself into oblivion!

The freewill robots attack and wage war on North Am while Magnus discovers a telltale sign of how to tell if a robot has freewill or not and continues to question whether or not these robots are alive or just machines in “Steel Nation Part Two -- Soldier.”

Fighting rogue Freewills, day and night, the mighty Magnus tests his stamina. Meanwhile, O-1X realizes that all the Freewills give off a distinct vibration, making it possible to find them and hunt them down. In his home, Magnus is befriended by W23, a Freewill robot who makes Magnus reconsider his war on Freewills. But such peaceful thoughts must be put aside, as O-1X's forces take a preemptive strike against the Robot Fighter!

Contains a coupon for Magnus # 0.

This is a tale of Magnus before he became the protector of North Am. As a young man constantly training to fight rogue robots, Magnus begins feeling burned-out. On advice from Grandmother, 1-A decides to take Magnus on a vacation to Mars. There, Magnus thwarts a Freewill plan to kidnap the Martian Governor's daughter! Returning the girl to her family, Magnus heads back to Earth with 1-A, once again eager to train.

Young Magnus visits North Am for the very first time with 1-A.

First appearance of Bloodhound and Deidre Hill.

Magnus returns to the asylum that 1-A created on Phobos and discovers that things have changed and not for the better and that a new version of an old threat is going to invade Earth in “Armageddon 4002 Part One – Slaughter on Phobos.”

Arriving at the Asylum on Phobos, Magnus discovers that powerful, new robots have taken over and murdered the inmates. Only Izak survives to learn with Magnus that these are robots from Malev-6, out to conquer Earth in retaliation for Magnus's destruction of their own robot planet. Captured by the Malev Emperor, Magnus must watch helplessly as the evil robots launch their all-out invasion of North Am!

Variant Cover: Gold Logo (see cover below).

1st. appearances:

- Malevolents

- Malev Emperor

issue_title: Holocaust 4002 Part 2: The Invasion Of North Am
description:
As Magnus is trapped on Phobos and tries to find a way to escape, the Malev empire unleashes a brutal and massive attack on Earth in “Holocaust 4002 Part Two – The Invasion of North Am.”

The merciless Malevs invade North Am, capturing those capable of generating ectotheric energy and slaughtering the rest! Professor Talltrees and his daughter, Willow, as well as Felina, are among Magnus's friends who die in the attack. And President Clane himself is captured while Leeja barely escapes! Leeja finds that she can turn the ectotheric energy against the Malevs, but can she survive until Magnus returns?

Death of Wollow Talltrees.

issue_title: Holocaust 4002 Part 3: The Fall Of The Milespires!
description: The attack on Earth continues as Magnus races back to Earth and is unaware that a Malev is a hidden stowaway on board his ship and Leeja discovers that she has abilities which enable her to strike back against the Malev robots in “Holocaust 4002 Part Three – The Fall of the Milespires.”

issue_title: Holocaust 4002 Part 4: The Fall Of North Am
description: As the Malev empire meets with the robots of Synchron, Leeja, Timbuc, Elzy and Slagger unite and try to get to Magnus who is recovering in Synchron in “Holocaust 4002 Part Four – The Fall of North Am.”

As Malevs continue their destructive path, Magnus returns to where 1-A trained him when he was young and he learns more about his past and then puts on a new costume of battle armor and hopes it’s not too late in “Flesh & Steel.”

Pert and Spikey, two friends from Magnus’ past, recall the robot fighter’s adventures and all that he has done to other survivors of the destructive battle in North Am in “Exemplar.”  
 
1st appearance:
-  Young Wolves

Magnus’ old foe Lazlo Noel returns to battle the Malevs but his plans are to do whatever it takes and whatever it costs to defeat the Malevs which means destroying the weather-control station. And Magnus can’t let him do that in “The Enemy of My Enemy.”
Another old foe of Magnus, Mekman, returns in a newly remade form and serves the Malevs as the new Vizier and does battle with Magnus and Noel in “Will of Iron.”

Magnus and company attack a Malev prisoner camp and then face the problem of what to do with and how to help the prisoners who are helpless and apparently in no shape to fight the Malevs in “Indomitable.” Guest starring the Eternal Warrior and the Geomancer.

Branded for treason for allowing a freewill robot to escape, Magnus has to go underground and off the grid and finds a surprising ally as the freewill robots attack Central Rob in “Steel Nation Part Three -- Traitor.”

The Freewill Uprising has truly begun. The president is assassinated, and the Milespires are burning! In the midst of this, Magnus calls for peace, only to be hunted as a traitor! Even so, Magnus fights to keep Central-rob from falling to thousands of attacking Freewills. But O-1X has upgraded his brain and can dominate the robots of North Am, and he now demands the slaughter of Humanity.

Contains a coupon for Magnus # 0.

1st. Appearance:

- Elzy

- General Mimsy

W-23 becomes Tekla

issue_title: The Battle For South Am - Chapter Two: Aryantina
description: The battle for South Am continues (Part One was in Rai and the Future Force #15 and future chapters alternate between Magnus and Rai) as Magnus and company try to prevent the XO Manowar Armor from falling into the Malevs’ hands in “The Battle for South Am Part Two -- Aryantina.”

issue_title: The Battle For South Am - Chapter Four: Allies
description: When they learn that the Malevs’ plan is to destroy the forests which would destroy Earth’s air recycling plants and enable the Malevs to poison the atmosphere and make the planet uninhabitable for humans, Magnus and company try to stop that plan and find help in the Rain Forest in “The Battle for South Am Part Four – Allies.”
When a Malev robot unit unexpectedly develops freewill, Magnus, the freewill robots and the Malevs want to obtain that robot but each side has different reasons in “Mal-Adjusted.”

issue_title: If This Is Tuesday, This Must Be... North Am?
description: When Ivar accidently gets transported to the North Am in 4002 right in the middle of the Malev war, Magnus has to protect him from the Malevs who want to possess the secrets of time travel in “If This Is Tuesday, This Must Be…North Am?”

In Australia, the most human oriented nation on Earth where people have rejected robots and a centralized computer network, both sides of the Malev war seek to get the country on their side in “Christmas Even: Minutes to Midnight.” The story continues in Rai and the Future Force #19.

As the Malevs’ dominion over Earth grows, Magnus tries to figure out where the war and his relationship with Leeja went wrong. But before he can do anything about it, a Malev attack occurs in “Champions Are Born, Not Made.” The story continues in Rai and the Future Force #20.  
 
Death of Mekman.

With the Malevs’ attempts to make Earth uninhabitable likely to happen within a year, Magnus decides that they need to launch a final assault on the Malev emperor. Meanwhile, Leeja goes into labor and the Malevs believe that the child will have incredible power and want to capture it in “The Beasts and the Children.”    
 
1st appearance:
-  Psi Lords (ship only)

Psi Lords themselfes appear for the first time in RAI # 21 - same month as Magnus # 36.

The Hexstrike Alpha team of the Starwatcher Sol Quorum joins up with Magnus and company for the final assault on the Malev empire in “The Last Day Part One -- Mindlock.”   
 
1st appearance:

-  Obadiah - Son of Rai (Takao Konishi) and Leeja. Birth!

With the Malev Empire defeated, Magnus now has to figure out how to bring everyone in the world together and rebuild society and fix all of the problems that now plague everyone in “New World Order.”   
 
1st appearance:

-  Torque (Son of Magnus and Leeja). Birth!
Magnus and Leeja’s son Torque proves to be troublesome as he tries to find a place in the world for himself and also gets caught in a love triangle in “Bizarre Love Triangle.”

The freewill robots gain control of Central-Rob and demand Magnus’ surrender. As Tekla tries to find a peaceful solution to everything, D-15 gains a new, more powerful robotic body to battle Magnus who infiltrates Central Rob in an attempt to stop the conflict in “Steel Nation Part Four -- Savior.”

With O-1X in command of North Am's robots, all humans are rounded up for execution. Only Tekla argues with O-1X, asking that he show mercy. Then Magnus arrives, battling through the Freewills until he beheads O-1X himself! Sick of the fighting, Magnus demands that the remaining Freewills be allowed to pursue their lives with Tekla leading them. Forsaking the Milespires, Magnus heads for the Goph levs.

issue_title: The Geomancer Quest - Part 1: A Snake In The Garden
description: Magnus’ son Torque gets sent on a fake quest to find the geomancer’s successor while Magnus is trying to make his way home in “The Geomancer Quest Part One – A Snake in the Garden.”

issue_title: The Geomancer Quest - Part 2: The Snows Of Triton
description:
When Magnus discovers that some guards were secretly sent by Minister Stimpert (who is possessed by the Immortal Enemy) to kill him, he then has to secretly make his way back home while Torque and Slagger continue their quest to find Armstrong and make him the new geomancer in “The Geomancer Quest Part Two – The Snows of Triton.”  
 
With Sneak Peek Card.

issue_title: The Geomancer Quest - Part 3:Trial By Combat
description: Leeja tries to figure out what is going on and how Minister Stimpert who is possessed by the Immortal Enemy is controlling her father while Torque and Slagger, still on their quest to find Armstrong to become the new geomancer, are in a mining community with a deadly form of legal system in “The Geomancer Quest Part Three – Trial By Combat.”

issue_title: The Geomancer Quest - Part 4: Father Figure
description: The Immortal Enemy now possesses Magnus’ body and Leeja and Torque have to come up with a way to save him in “The Geomancer Quest Part Four – Father Figure.”
While Magnus and Leeja have to be apart, Leeja is kidnapped by a pair of robots who claim to be with a robotic right to life alliance which starts making requests for robots in “Cold Blooded.”
With his wife still held hostage by the robotic right to life alliance, Magnus tries to rescue her and then finds that they have fled and he’ll have to hunt them down in “Hardened Heart.”
Something strange is going on and Slagger and others try to find out what it is. And when Slagger disappears, Magnus has to investigate in “The Invisible Legion Part One.”

issue_title: Invasion Part 1: Goph Rules  /  Invasion Part 2: Spirit Against The Flesh
description:
With North Am in disarray, the Japanese Ambassador arrives in search of Magnus, who has gone to live as a Goph. In a Goph bar, Magnus befriends Felina, whose boyfriend, Slagger, thinks Magnus is out to steal his woman! The resulting fight inspires mutual respect, and a rugged friendship is born! But North Am troops come to arrest Magnus for abandoning the Milespires, so he goes to Japan with the Ambassador.

issue_title: Return Of The Robots - Part One
description: A robot invasion starts and these robots are not freewills nor Malevs but something new that Magnus and company have to deal with in “Return of the Robots Part One.”

issue_title: Return Of The Robots - Part Two
description: The battle against the new robots continues and Magnus and company have to face their own individual battles and conflicts in “Return of the Robots Part Two.”

issue_title: Whose Planet Is It Anyway? - Part One
description: The Psi Lords come to Earth to take care of things and make sure that things stay peaceful their way and Magnus is not happy about that in “Whose Planet Is It, Anyway? – Part One.”

issue_title: Whose Planet Is It Anyway? - Part Two
description: The Psi Lords’ first mandate is to protect all life but it doesn’t say how they go about that and Magnus and company have to deal with that in “Whose Planet Is It Anyway? – Part Two.”
Rai journeys down to the lower levels of North Am in search of Magnus who is not in good shape and Rai tries to find out what happened and why.
Rai has brought Magnus to his sanctuary hoping that it will help him recover from whatever ails him but others wonder if there is another reason.

As Magnus struggles to recover from an assassination attempt, he is plagued by nightmares of his past and Rai tries to find out who is responsible for the assassination attempt.

Death of Tekla.

issue_title: Invasion Part 3: Just Say Noh  /  Invasion Part 4: Killing Stroke
description:
Special “Flip” issue in which one side has a Magnus cover and story, then you flip the comic and the other side has a Rai cover and story. Magnus journeys to Japan where the council asks him to destroy Grandmother, a machine that controls everything in the country and is believed to have developed freewill. But Solar appears and warns Magnus not to destroy Grandmother because of an approaching Alien invasion and Rai, inside Grandmother, tries to figure out what is wrong in “Invasion Part Three – Just Say Noh!” and “Invasion Part Four – Killing Stroke”

Having saved Ambassador Tsuda from a Ninjatron, Magnus arrives in Japan to learn that he has been summoned to overthrow the Japanese caretaker computer, Grandmother. Then, after a thousand-year absence, Solar appears, warning Magnus to protect Grandmother against the impending Spider Alien Invasion! But Magnus is too late to stop Tsuda from infecting Grandmother with a deadly, alien carcinopod!

Contains a coupon for Magnus # 0.

Final issue.

issue_title: Invasion Part 5: The Ballad Of East Of West  /  Invasion Part 6: Small Sacrifice
description:
Special “Flip” issue in which one side has a Magnus cover and story, then you flip the comic and the other side has a Rai cover and story. With grandmother “killed,” Magnus, Rai and 1-A work to find a way to bring her back to life as the invading alien force approaches and Rai seeks to save his son which brings him into a conflict with Magnus in “Invasion Part Five – The Ballad of East and West” and “Invasion Part Six – Small Sacrifice”

Rai attacks the man he thinks killed Grandmother- - Magnus! But, Magnus shows him that an alien weapon felled Grandmother, so Rai departs to find his son in the chaos. When 1-A arrives, Magnus attempts a desperate plan to revive Grandmother by implanting 1-A's core within her body. The two Freewill minds combine, and Grand-One is born! At last, the Host Body of Japan can be mobilized against the Spider Alien invasion fleet!

Contains a coupon for Magnus # 0.

issue_title: Invasion Part 7: Enter The Dragon  /  Invasion Part 8: Supernova
description:
Special “Flip” issue in which one side has a Magnus cover and story, then you flip the comic and the other side has a Rai cover and story. With Grandmother repaired and in full battle mode against the invading alien forces, Magnus and Rai have to join the fight against overwhelming odds and hope that Solar can help in “Invasion Part Seven – Enter the Dragon” and “Invasion Part Eight – Supernova”

Like an impossibly huge robotic dragon, the Host Body of Japan rises into space to battle the Spider Alien invasion fleet! Aiding in the cause are Magnus, Rai, and Solar! Nearby, in an alien craft, Rai's wife, Kazuyo, steals a Commando-Class X-O Armor and returns to earth to save her infant son. In space, the aliens penetrate Japan's Skull-Dome, threatening to overpower Rai and Magnus and destroy the Grand-One!

Contains a coupon for Magnus # 0.

issue_title: The Xyrkol Trilogy Part 1: The Rise
description:
Magnus returns to North Am but is not welcome and has to flee to the Goph level; Leeja remains in Synchron and tries to improve herself; and President Clane starts a war against Synchron in “The Xyrkol Trilogy Part One – The Rise.”

Returning from Japan to North Am, Magnus finds that he is a wanted man for helping the Freewills establish their own nation. In the Freewill city of Synchron, Leeja works to learn inner strength from Tekla and the others. When Magnus informs President Clane that his daughter wishes to remain in Synchron, Clane orders that Magnus be psycho-probed and that North Am declare war on the Freewill Steel Nation!

1st appearance:

- Xyrkol

issue_title: Second Death Part 1: No Place Like Home / Alpha And Omega Part 1
description:
Second Death. Part One: No Place Like Home

Finding himself floating above Earth, disoriented, Phil Seleski returns home, only to find another him in his apartment! Confused, he departs to stop a prison riot and raise a damaged Soviet nuclear sub. But, strangely, it seems the world isn't ready for a super-being doing good deeds. Finally realizing he has somehow come back through time, Phil cannot remember how. But he knows he's repressing a memory too terrible to bear!

Alpha and Omega. Part One

In chapter one, the experimental fusion reactor at the Edgewater Fusion Energy Research Center a.k.a. "the Edge" runs out of control, threatening to erupt into a sun-like fireball that will kill millions.

Doctor Phil Seleski, the principal designer of the device, realizing that his obsession with unlocking the secrets of fusion has led to catastrophe, races into the containment to attempt to shut the reactor down manually.

issue_title: The Man Who Killed The World / Alpha And Omega Part 10
description:
Young Geoff McHenry is taught the secrets of the Geomancers by his uncle Buck. Able to hear the voices of objects and the Earth, Geoff senses the threat to all Creation posed by a "Sun-demon" whom he believes to be Solar. So, with the help of the Eternal Warrior and the Harbinger Foundation's Eggbreakers, a plan is made to trap Solar beneath a force field and finally rid the world of the menace he presents!

2nd printing - see pic below.

Trapped by a force-field, Solar is under attack by the Eggbreakers! But Geoff no longer feels that Solar is the "Sun Demon" he fears will destroy the world. So, as Solar strives not to hurt the misguided Eggbreakers, Gilad convinces Harada to call off the attack. Now, Solar and Geoff go to the home of Erica Pierce, only to find that she has been murdered by her superhuman counterpart from the world Solar destroyed!

issue_title: Unity Chapter 9: ...And Then There Was One
description:
Unity Chapter NINE

Coming to our world from the one Solar destroyed, Erica Pierce kills her real-world counterpart and takes her son, Albert! Moving to the Lost Land, Erica prepares her Unity plan to wipe all Creation. Elsewhen, Geoff's geomantic senses lead him and Solar to the Lost Land. Under attack by Erica's minions, Solar sends Geoff for help. Geoff must succeed, for when Solar confronts Erica, he is lured into her wormhole trap!

issue_title: Unity Chapter 17: Dreams That You Dare
description:
Unity Chapter SEVENTEEN

Trapped in a cincture wormhole, Solar is freed by Sting of the Harbinger kids. Meanwhile, Prince Albert's plan to kill Mothergod with Rai's sword fails. Before she can retaliate, the heroes storm the citadel. Solar and Mothergod face off as the Unity reaction begins to destroy all of time! Trapping Mothergod in a wormhole of his own devising, Solar uses his power to undo the Unity effect and send all the heroes home!

Back from the Unity Conflict, Phil goes back to pursuing a normal life. With the Edgewater plant shut down, Phil finds he has plenty of time to enjoy falling in love with Gayle all over again. But all the while, an investigator named Fred Bender is unraveling the secret that Phil Seleski is actually Solar! And when the man begins to hound him, Phil gives him a glimpse of the quantum continuum, only to have Bender steal a portion of his power!

1st appearance:

- Dr. Eclipse (Fred Bender)

Above Muskogee, Solar pursues Fred Bender, who has stolen some of his awesome power. The wily Bender gives Solar the slip and goes off to play with his dangerous new abilities. But Bender's sanity proves fragile and his whims begin to claim lives! Solar finally catches the man and whisks him away to the terrifying quantum maelstrom where Solar strips him of is power and leaves him stranded in the middle of the desert.

As Phil and Gayle prepare to move to California, they are summoned to meet with Toyo Harada. They cautiously accept and find that Harada has captured three Spider Aliens. Thinking he had slain the last of them, Phil is shocked to learn that aliens still maintain a base on the dark side of the Moon! Unwilling to be manipulated by Harada into destroying the base, Phil quickly changes his mind when the captives nearly kill Gayle.

Solar goes to destroy the Spider Alien Moonbase, only to learn that the aliens have summoned Aric there to take his X-O Armor. With the Armor's Seed, they can grow a starship and return to their Homeworld. Seeing an opportunity to follow the aliens and destroy their Homeworld, Solar battles X-O, hoping Aric will realize that giving up the Seed now could eventually result in the final defeat of the Spider Aliens!

Back from the Spider Alien Moonbase, Phil recalls that before he destroyed the world, he had averted some imminent nuclear disasters. But the infamy he gained fixing those plants contributed to the horrifying downfall. So, this time around, he surreptitiously gets the plant personnel to notice the reactor leaks themselves, with no one the wiser that they were saved by the Man of the Atom!

Sneaking into a closed Virtual Reality exhibit, Phil and Gayle run the equipment on Phil's inner power. But something goes wrong as a Virtual Reality Creature takes Gayle captive! Through its link with Phil's power, the Creature reveals to Gayle that she was the first to die when Solar destroyed the other world! At first, too shocked to fight back, Gayle takes control and banishes the Creature. But for her and Phil, the damage has been done!

issue_title: Second Death Part 2: Out Of My Mind / Alpha And Omega Part 2
description:
Second Death Part Two: Out of My Mind

Having finally remembered that he was tossed back through time when he accidentally destroyed the Earth in a black hole, Phil must now prevent that terrible mistake from being repeated! Unable to convince Dr. Dobson to shut down the Edgewater reactor, Phil suffers a seizure and splits into two superhuman personas. When these two clash in Antarctica, most of the ice-cap is vaporized.

Solar (first in costume - as Dr. Solar)

Alpha and Omega. Part Two

The experimental fusion reactor at the Edgewater Fusion Energy Research Center a.k.a. "the Edge" threatened to explode, killing millions. Doctor Phillip Seleski, principal designer of the device, raced into the containment, sacrificing his own life to shut the reactor down manually. Now, moments after the event is stilled, a team of technicians enters to recover Seleski's remains.

Following Rusk to the aliens' Chicago headquarters, Solar discovers that these aliens are stationed all over the planet with weapons capable of harming even a being of his immeasurable power! issue_title: First Strike Part 2:Massacre / Alpha And Omega Part 6
description: Near Saturn, Solar beholds the staggering might of the Spider Alien fleet. Aboard one of their starships, he discovers the horrifying truth: the aliens feed upon human blood, leaving shrivelled corpses! When Solar damages the onboard botanical enclosure, the Spiders, who revere plantlife, retaliate by sacrificing their human captives! Sickened beyond imagining, Solar begins the systematic destruction of the fleet.
Last Issue

issue_title: First Strike Part 2: Massacre / Alpha And Omega Part  7
description: As Solar destroys the Spider Alien fleet near Saturn, an alien warrior hurries to don his Manowar-class X-O Armor. At first unimpressed by this armored soldier, Solar soon learns that even he can succumb to the power of the Manowar! A desperate ploy provides Solar with the energy to beat his enemy, but some of the fleet have escaped to warn their Homeworld of the terrible Earthling they now call the Destroyer!

issue_title: First Strike Part 4:Common Foe / Alpha And Omega Part 8
description: Roughly a year after departing for Saturn to battle the Spider Aliens, Solar finally finds his way back to Earth. Upon returning, he finds information on an alien operation in Bangkok run by a Harbinger named Kama. Investigating, Solar finds that Harada is also there to end Kama's activites. Kama's psionic ability to sap men's will and cloud their minds proves so formidable, that bitter enemies Solar and Harada must team up to stop her!

Returning to the Edgewater facility, Phil finds Erica Pierce suffering from strange seizures. It turns out that she, too, gained energy powers from the same incident that empowered Phil. But Erica has an unborn child within her that leaves her body, developing at an incredible rate! Solar tries to control the dangerously powerful "God-child," but cannot prevent it from dissipating. Now, Pierce blames Solar for the death of her child.

1st appearance:

- Albert Pierce (son of Erica Pierce)

New York Times best-selling writer Greg Pak (Batman/Superman, Planet Hulk) and superstar artist Trevor Hairsine (X-O Manowar, X-Men: Deadly Genesis) launch a brand new campaign for Valiant’s immortal champion, the Eternal Warrior, in an all-new monthly series!

Across ten millennia and a thousand battlefields, Gilad Anni-Padda has traversed the darkest, most mysterious corners of history. But the horror and bloodshed of constant warfare has finally taken its toll on the man myth calls the Eternal Warrior…and he has abdicated his duties as the Fist and the Steel of Earth for a quiet life of seclusion. But when a blood vendetta from the distant past suddenly reappears in the modern day, he must decide if he will return to the ways of war…for the child who betrayed him thousands of years ago…

King Gilad Anni-Padda hoped to leave his days as the Eternal Emperor behind him. But when an unforeseen challenger emerges from Gilad’s past, the king must put down his crown and pick up his sword! Is the Eternal Warrior finally out of time?

Every moment in the centuries-long life of Gilad Anni-Padda has led to this moment. Far removed from the modern day, standing resolute at the last tattered edge of the civilization, the Eternal Emperor of 4001 A.D. is about to make the hardest choice of all – and two thousand years of Valiant heroes will feel the fallout. Don’t miss a moment as the very first vision of Valiant’s all-new future timeline reaches a milestone turning point!

At last - the landmark issue that laid the foundation for the future of the Valiant Universe, featuring the first appearance of Bloodshot! Guest-starring X-O Manowar, Archer, Shadowman, Toyo Harada, the Eternal Warrior and a cast of thousands, the next generation of Valiant heroes begins here! But just what is the Blood of Heroes? And how will it create a legacy that stretches from the modern day into the distant future?

Geoff, the Geomancer frees the hero known as Bloodshot from Project Rising Spirit. Years later, Shadowman dies to rid the world of the Darque Power! After that, the deaths of Archer, Aric and Bloodshot are all precursors to the great Harbinger Wars against Toyo Harada. During this struggle, the Blood of Heroes remains hidden. Finally, in 4002, Geomancer Rokland Tate bestows it upon Takao Konishi - the Last Rai!

This is a telling of the Rai history. It also gives us a detailed account of everything from The Unity Saga on up to the creation of Rai and The Future Force.

Along with that this issue serves as the origin story of Bloodshot.

Meet Takao Konishi, the last Rai! With the Blood of Heroes coursing through his veins, Rai will lead humanity's liberation from the all-knowing, all-powerful sentient nation known as Grandmother. But when you upset Grandmother, you must be punished.

Now that the Grandmother computer no longer rules Japan, the orbiting nation is split between the ruling Humanist party, and the Healers, who want to restore computer control. When the Healers attempt to steal a component from the Skull-dome control center, Rai and Kazuyo find themselves forced to battle a deadly Grandmother drone! But the terrible fight is only a diversion, designed to hide the Healers' true objective.

In this issue we meet Makiko Minashi a man who was raised from birth to be the protector of the people of Japan. He takes the title of Rai. He follows the teachings of Japans master computer called Grandmother. This makes it impossible for him to pick a side in the impending revolution.

Rai questions his leadership ability, but soon realizes that he must battle the Emperor and save all of humanity.

1st appearance:

- Mother Nike

Tokoa Konishi seeks council with Mother Nike, to debate on joining Magnus to North Am to fight Malev Emperor or stay and fight in Japan.
Rai and the Future Force must retreat after their failed assault on the Malevs. Will the heroes survive to fight another day?
Rai and the Future Force must defeat the Malevs -- mankind's mortal enemy. But when cyborg slavers attack, will our heroes be prepared?!

It seems that even nature is against Rai and the Future Force when they find themselves in the middle of the first full blown typhoon in a century! They are forced to take refuge in a strange land, but will they make new allies there or have to brave new threats?
The Malev Emperor is launching a new attack! Will Rai and the Future Force be able to fend the off and save their friends - or will they be too late?!

issue_title: The Battle For South Am-- Chapter One: One For All
description: Rai and the Future Force prepare for the Malev attack on North Am. Will the heroes be able to defeat this robotic menace?! And will Rai and Leeja's relationship finally be brought to light?

issue_title: The Battle For South Am-- Chapter Three: Targets
description: Something seems amiss as Rai and the Future Force investigate the Malev's plan. Could the Malev's plot be even worse than our heroes had anticipated?

Will squabbles between the members of the Future Force be enough to lead them astray? Or will they be able to overcome their differences to confront the Malev? And will they uncover the fate of Timbuc?
Rai and the Future Force stumble upon a 500 year old plantation whose workers are enslaved humans! How will the heroes deal with this horrendous reality?

Rai gets frostbite when Icespike strikes! Who is this mysterious new assassin and what has he sworn his life to protect? Only one thing is for sure… he wants Rai dead! Overwhelmed and outmatched by this vicious new foe, Rai must call on the unlikeliest of allies to win the day.

With many in Japan falling prey to Neo-plum addiction, Rai strikes at a facility producing the debilitating drug. But the task won't be easy, for the drug factory is guarded by Icespike, a super-assassin out to make his reputation by killing Rai. Rai and Kazuyo manage to beat him, but Icespike escapes capture. This defeat prompts the Healer leader, Councillor Seko, to make Rai's death his top priority.

In This issue, the followers of Grandma are angered at Rai for questioning her teachings at the end of issue #1. They end up hiring an assassin to kill the Rai, but soon regret it as he begins to attack any one or thing in order to complete his mission.
Death of Tekla.

This new series starts in the middle of the action well after the Cylons have already destroyed the colonies. As the Galactica passes near the widespread wreckage of a 60 year old battle between Caprica and Sagittarius, known as the Third Colonial Conflict, Apollo observes a fire on an old medivac ship that is part of the wreckage. Galactica receives a distress call from the medivac ship, claiming to be under attack by Cylons. Commander Adama sends Starbuck and a Marine squad to the ship. Once aboard, they discover the ship is under attack by older generation Cylons and immediately engage them in a firefight.

As the medivac ship’s passengers begin to identify themselves , the Galactica crew discovers that those aboard the ship are Colonial citizens who had previously died. Commander Adama orders Starbuck and her squad to pull out suspecting that those on the medivac ship are, in fact, Cylons themselves. As Starbuck receives the order, she discovers among the ship’s passengers Zak Adama, Commander Adama’s dead son.

Starbuck confronts Zak, accusing him of being a Cylon. Zak admits that he doesn’t know how he has returned, but denies being a Cylon. Commander Adama has serious misgivings about Zak and the other returners but decides to quarantine the returners old medivac ship rather than destroy it. The returners, unhappy with the quarantine order, board zip pods to abandon their ship and reunite with their families on the various ships in the Colonial fleet. Featuring covers from Nigel Raynor, Joe Prado, Stephen Segovia and a New Battlestar Photo Cover!

Darrin, Dualla’s brother who should be dead, is captured and placed in Galactica’s brig. Dualla questions her brother who tells her that he doesn’t remember anything after his death, but that he simply woke up on the medivac ship with the Cylons attacking. Many in the fleet believe the returners are a fulfillment of an ancient prophecy found in the Sacred Scrolls--“The dead shall return in an ark of fire,” and work to hide the returners even though almost everyone who comes in contact with the returners becomes ill. Zak is shuttled aboard Galactica by a group sympathetic to the returners. When the group becomes sick, Zak calls for help and finds himself looking down the barrel of a gun held by his brother, Apollo.

Apollo after taking Zak to the brig, begins to interrogate him. During the interrogation, Zak figures out that Apollo has a relationship with his former fiancé, Starbuck, and attacks Apollo. During their brief fight, a member of the Earth Protectorate terrorist group breaks in but is subdued before he can kill Apollo. Apollo then learns that Galactica’s pilots are being targeted by the group. He and Zak hunt down and kill two of the terrorists, but shortly after, Apollo succumbs to the virus sweeping the ship.

The story ends with an older generation Cylon Basestar appearing.

With only three Viper pilots available (Adama, Starbuck, and Zak), Adama launches a plan to set off a nuclear weapon on the Basestar that is hovering near the Galactica, the Battlestar obscured within the wreckage of a sixty-year-old battle. Neither Adama nor Starbuck trusting Zak. Baltar discovers a room on Medivac 12 that proves the returners were created by the Cylons. The room is filled with partially grown clones in human-sized test tubes.

Adama is successful in detonating the nuclear weapon, but the resulting explosion damages all three Vipers, Starbuck’s fatally so. Zak quickly positions his Viper near Starbuck’s and does a soft eject. He pulls her from her Viper and places her in the seat of his Viper, leaving himself drifting in space near the other Viper. The badly damaged Viper explodes, seemingly killing Zak.

As Starbuck and Adama rejoin each other, multiple Cylon Raiders approach their position; however, they soon discover these older model Cylons follow the orders of humans. The story ends with Adama leading the Raiders back to Galactica.

Adama and Starbuck return to Galactica with the early model Cylons. While on Galactica the Cylons prevent an assassination attempt on President Roslin and a separate attempt on Colonel Tigh. One older generation Cylon detects that Sharon is a Cylon and, determining that she is a threat, breaks into her cell and attacks her, apparently killing her. At the same moment another version of Sharon awakens in the cockpit of a Raptor, only to discover that she is under attack by several free-floating humans in space suits.

The second version of Sharon defends herself against an attack on her Raptor by several free-floating humans in space suits. Those attacking her are hoping to capture her to barter her for time aboard ship. The attackers were originally part of a satellite construction team left stranded in space when the Cylons destroyed their ships. The men’s only island is a small barge that can house only twenty people at a time. The men can only earn barge time by bartering something of interest to the barge’s captain, in this case, Sharon.

On board Galactica, the older generation Cylons continue their attack on Sharon until Adama presses the self-destruct button on a remote, causing the Cylons to explode. Baltar had equipped each of the Cylons with small explosive devices in their helmets. Dr. Cottle is able to revive Sharon.

At the barge, the other Sharon convinces her attackers that they should take over the barge, which they do, with Sharon killing the captain and taking his position.

Marco Leesa, a returner, and his daughter Jenny are attacked by members of the Earth Protectorate, a terrorist group that believes killing the returners will prevent the Cylons from attacking Earth. Marco loses an arm and a leg in the attack, but does manage to save his daughter.

At the barge, the other Sharon successfully transfers her FTL drive from her Raptor to the barge, intending to return to Galactics. Upon her return, she sees the older generation Cylons surrounding Colonial One; Sharon and her men board the ship and attack the Cylons. When Roslin confronts her, Sharon is confused and has a difficult time accepting these Cylons. Adama arrives with the original Sharon, which makes the other Sharon realize that she herself is a Cylon. She then flees and discovers that a group of newer generation Cylons are readying to attack.

The other Sharon boards one of the older generation Cylon Raiders and using her blood splashed over the helmeted face of the Cylon pilot gains control of all the older generation Cylons. A group of newer generation Cylons attacks Colonial One, but their primary target is not President Roslin, but rather the older generation Cylons. Adama tells the other Sharon to assemble the older generation Cylons on the starboard side of the ship and then lures the newer generation Cylons to attack the older generation. Once outside the ship, Sharon immediately takes control of the newer generation Cylons as well. Sharon announces her farewell as Adama in the last panel of the story is about to press the self-destruct button on his remote to destroy all the Cylons.

The other Sharon runs a program giving both generations of Cylons freedom of choice. She then announces her intention to return to the main Cylon base to discover who she really is. Adama convinces many of the returners to go with her and both groups of Cylons.

When members of the Earth Protectorate take Baltar hostage, Adama, working with Sharon’s Cylons are able to rescue him. Afterwards, Sharon, the Cylons, and the returners leave Galactica and return to the Cylon’s main base ship.

The other Sharon, the Returners, and her group of older and newer generation Cylons return to the Cylon’s main base ship where she seeks answers to who she is. The base ship sends Raiders to attack Sharon’s ship, but she quickly gains control of the Raiders and enters the main base ship. Sharon is eventually separated from the Rreturners, who attempt to set explosives on the ship. Sharon enters the forbidden garden and discovers the seat of all her memories and meets with Stan, her oldest childhood friend, who tells her she is actually Sharon Prime, the real human Sharon.
